title: Design Director
description:
**Are you passionate about creating exceptional user experiences while inspiring a talented creative team to thrive?**
 We are looking for a
 **Design Director** 
 who balances strategic design vision with empowering team management and a pragmatic, execution-focused mindset. We have a bold ambition to be the undisputed #1 service in the eyes of our consumers. To get there, we need a leader who has successfully built and elevated design practices before—someone who knows what "great" looks like, both in the final user experience and in the best-in-class ways of working that get us there.
   

  

 You will play a fundamental role in translating our consumer-centric strategy and ambition into world-class design execution that drives real user, business, and brand impact.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
 As the Design Director at Instabee, your mission is to embed user-centricity into our cross-functional initiatives and workflows, implement insights-driven design practices, and lead and develop our team of product and brand designers. You will collaborate closely with colleagues and stakeholders in strategy, product, analytics, tech, and operations. Together with your peers in Consumer, you will establish consumer ambassadorship and center of excellence - ensuring the consumer experience is top-of-mind in everything we do.
   

  

**Your Responsibilities Fall Into Three Key Pillars**
* Drive Design Strategy & Transformation
* Develop and continuously hone the design practices at Instabee to achieve our high consumer experience ambitions, desired brand position, user-centricity, efficiency, and business outcomes.
* Champion the end-to-end user perspective across all development phases, from discovery and design execution to post-launch optimization.
* Demonstrate the value of great design for our user experience and business goals, building trust, credibility and the strong internal relationships needed to give design a strong voice in company decisions.
* Ensure our design organization stays on the forefront of the craft: exploring and putting emerging methodologies and technologies into practice.
* Lead and Empower the Design Team
* Recruit, coach, develop, and lead a high-performing, multidisciplinary team of product and brand designers working with teams and stakeholders across the organization.
* Oversee brand and product design for Growth, Operations, Markets, and other key teams. Translate strategic business objectives and priorities into clear design strategy, adapting resources and capabilities to effectively support the organization and focus where it matters most.
* Champion high standards for design execution. Ensure design output is cohesive, high-quality, and clearly connected to user and business goals.
* Deliver Senior Design Excellence
* Keep one foot in the craft, driving own high-impact product and UX/UI design work - leading by example and showcasing best practices.
* Raise the bar for design and design processes across digital, physical and human interactions, ensuring we deliver "brilliant basics" enhanced by targeted signature “wow moments” that differentiate us.
* Act as a strong facilitator bringing cross-functional experts together to solve complex consumer challenges and drive user-centric innovation.


**Your Profile**
* 8+ years of experience in senior consumer-focused design or product UX/UI roles within a fast-paced service, product, or tech environment.
* A proven track record of design execution that drives clear user, business, and brand impact.
* Solid experience building, leading and elevating multidisciplinary design teams. Skilled at unlocking the potential of different individuals and design disciplines.
* A working-leader mindset, with a passion for keeping your own senior design craft sharp and a desire to lead by example.
* Strong change management capabilities, with a history of successfully integrating design best practices into cross-functional work and influencing without formal ownership.
* A systems-thinking approach, allowing you to see the full customer journey across touchpoints while seamlessly moving between high-level strategic alignment and hands-on operational details.
* Great communication, facilitation and leadership skills, enabling you to build trust, inspire teams, and confidently navigate complex cross-organizational environments as a strong voice for the consumer and the business value of design.


**What You’ll Get**
 We can promise you that you will be challenged, develop your skills and have the opportunity to work with truly amazing and competent colleagues. If you like changes and want to set new processes and ways of working - this is the place for you!
   

  

**Benefits**
 Of course, we have all the necessary and standard benefits in place, but in addition to this, we can also offer:
   

  

* Sky-High Office: Modern and newly renovated with a 360-degree view around Stockholm.
* Puppy Friendly: Bring your dog to work - we've got a whole floor for our furry friends!
* Fun & Games: Ping pong, Shuffleboard, Foosball, and even a Karaoke Room for your leisure time.
* Parental Pay for Six Months: Step away from work and provide the best care and love to your little one.
* A Day Off on Your Birthday: We love to celebrate, so enjoy your birthday to the fullest with a day off each year!
* Hybrid setup and flexible working hours


**Get to know us**
 In 2022, Instabee was founded after combining Budbee and Instabox - two leading last-mile delivery companies with three consumer-facing brands: Budbee, Instabox, and Porterbuddy. Instabee serves millions of consumers across Europe with convenient deliveries and is on track to become the leading European e-commerce enabler. Always with the consumer at heart.
   

  

 We’re fast, both in terms of parcel delivery and when it comes to growing our business. So far our journey has taken us from Sweden to the rest of Scandinavia and parts of continental Europe, but we have no plans on stopping anytime soon. As we continue to expand, the complexity of Instabee grows in parallel. With that in mind, we’re now looking for you to help us on the journey ahead.
   

  

*This recruitment process consists of background checks via Svensk Bakgrundsanalys as a review of previous public criminal records. The result is public information that is handled confidentially. This is mandatory for all recruitment processes at Instabee in Sweden.*
**Please note that, due to the summer holiday period, we will begin reviewing applications in August. We appreciate your patience and will be in touch with all candidates once the recruitment process resumes.**
 Instabee Group, with consumer-facing brands Budbee, Instabox, and Porterbuddy, brings together years of experience in delivery. Today, Instabee Group is present in five markets, serving thousands of online merchants and millions of consumers with seamless home deliveries and convenient parcel locker deliveries, using the best fuel available. With smart technology, a strong focus on sustainability, and a secure supply chain, Instabee has become a trusted partner for online merchants and a preferred choice for consumers.

title: Product Manager
description:
**About Extenda Retail** 




 Extenda Retail builds the technology behind some of the most ambitious retailers in Europe and beyond. Our cloud-native Hii Retail platform unifies the entire in-store and omnichannel experience on a single, modern foundation.
 



 At the core of the platform sits Hii Checkout: one engine powering every transaction across Point of Sales (POS), self-checkout, Mobile Point of Sales (MPO) and Scan & Go (SCO). It's built on MACH principles — microservices, API-first, cloud-native and headless — and runs on Google Cloud. When you're building checkout apps for brands like
 **ICA, Axfood, Plantagen, and Auchan** 
 , you are designing for millions of daily interactions. This is genuinely modern retail software, and we're building it for the next decade, not the last one.
 



  





**Why should you join Extenda Retail?** 




 Extenda Retail is the kind of place where people tend to stay longer than they planned to, not because of the perks, but because the work is real and the people around them are good. The culture is demanding, but in the right way: high expectations, genuine ownership and a shared interest in getting things right. The values (trust, care & innovation) aren't decorative. They show up in how decisions get made and how people treat each other when things get hard. There's a genuine care for the people here, not as a stated policy, but as something you actually feel. If you want a place to grow, be challenged, and do work that matters, this is it!
 



  





**The role** 




 This role is part of
 **Product Strategy and Management** 
 which is a department led by our CPO and manned with senior people deciding what Extenda Retail builds. We're deliberate about why we build what we build and we're separate from engineering, that decides how we build it.
 



 We're looking for a
 **Product Manager to own our Checkout Apps** 
 : POS, SCO and MPOS. These are the products closest to the moment that matters most in retail: the transaction itself, where a stressed cashier, a queueing shopper or someone scanning their own basket either has a smooth experience — or doesn't.
 



 That makes this a deeply
 **UX-driven** 
 role. You'll care as much about how it feels to ring up an order at peak hour as about what's on the roadmap. You think in flows and friction, not just features.
 **You'll own your area end to end** 
 which means strategy, roadmap, discovery and outcomes. You will work side by side with UX design and engineering to turn a strong platform into checkout products that staff and shoppers genuinely love to use. You won't be handed a backlog to administer. You'll be expected to form a sharp point of view about the experience we should build, and drive it.
 



  





**Product Management at Extenda Retail** 




 As the Product Manager for
 **Checkout Apps (POS, SCO, MPOS),** 
 you will own the product strategy and roadmap, aligning it closely with our broader Hii Retail vision. You’ll be part of a team of product managers collaborating across the product suite, working in lockstep with the engineering teams who develop and deliver the products. You will
 **obsess over the end-user experience** 
 , both for store staff at the POS and shoppers in self-service and mobile flows—by hunting down friction, reducing steps,
 **increasing clarity and visibility,** 
 and making complex interactions feel effortless. From the very start of discovery, you’ll
 **partner** 
 closely with
 **UX/design** 
 to shape solutions together and sweat the details that make checkout fast, clear, and reliable.
 



  





 To achieve this, you will talk directly to retailers, store staff, and shoppers to deeply understand the realities of the checkout environment, translating those insights into sharp problem statements and validating them quickly through prototypes, store visits, and data. You will
 **prioritize ruthlessly** 
 to turn a long wish-list into a focused, high-impact roadmap,
 **collaborating with pre-sales, customer success, and commercial teams** 
 to ensure what we build lands beautifully in live deployments.
 



 Innovation is at the heart of this role: you will continuously look for opportunities to embed AI into POS and self-service flows as a native part of the UI rather than a bolt-on. Furthermore,
 **you will use modern AI tools (like Claude and Gemini) as a core part of your daily workflow** 
 to accelerate research, synthesis, and spec-writing, constantly raising the bar on quality and speed.
 



  





**What you bring** 




 You are a proactive, impact-driven Product Manager who thrives in ambiguity and cares deeply about product craft: clunky user experiences genuinely bother you. You define success by user and business outcomes rather than feature count, and you build alignment across technical and commercial teams through clear context rather than authority. Always curious about the future of the PM craft, you actively integrate AI into your daily workflow and are excited to design it natively into user experiences. Above all, you value progress over perfection, relying on continuous learning and smart iteration to build great products.
 



  





**We think your background looks something like this:** 



* **Product Ownership:** 
 3–5 years of SaaS Product Management experience, ideally owning a substantial product area end-to-end with a track record of delivering successful, highly utilized product features
* **UX & Craft:** 
 A strong instinct for usability and interaction design, with a deep care for making interfaces fast, intuitive, and frictionless (hands-on UX experience is a big plus).
* **Technical & Commercial Judgment:** 
 Solid technical instincts—comfortable discussing APIs and architecture with engineers while balancing value and trade-offs with commercial teams.
* **AI-First Workflow:** 
 Hands-on fluency using modern AI tools (e.g., Claude, Lovable) for prototyping, research, and accelerating discovery as a natural part of your daily routine.
* **Drive & Communication:** 
 Excellent English communication skills, a strong bias for action, comfort with ambiguity, and a commitment to continuous learning.



  





**Nice to Have (But Not Required)** 




 While not prerequisites, we would love to see experience in:
 


* UX/interaction design, usability research, or design-led product work.
* Retail software (POS, checkout, payments, in-store systems, or omnichannel commerce).
* Cloud-native / MACH architectures (microservices, API-first, headless).
* Working with enterprise customers across multiple markets.



  





*Retail experience is a plus, not a must. If you are a strong, UX-minded SaaS PM who is excited by this domain, we want to hear from you!*

title: Product Analyst
description:
We are Sweden's leading app and marketplace for booking beauty and wellness services. As a SaaS company with industry-leading software, we empower more than 16,000 professionals across the country. Our platform brings together nearly every salon and clinic in Sweden, making it easy for consumers to book appointments with hairdressers, massage therapists, podiatrists, beauty salons, chiropractors, and many other specialists—all in one place.
   

  

 On Bokadirekt.se, consumers can discover, book, and pay for treatments and services in just a few clicks. Every month, our platform is visited by 3 million consumers, and more than 2 million bookings are made through our website and app. We’re growing rapidly and are currently a team of more than 100 employees, with offices in Stockholm and Luleå.
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are looking for a Product Analyst to join our Data & Analytics team and serve as the dedicated analytics partner to our Product organisation.
   

  

 As a Product Analyst, you will help our product teams make better decisions through data. You'll work closely with product managers, designers, and engineers to uncover user insights, measure product performance, and drive experimentation across the customer journey. You'll play a key role in establishing best practices for product analytics, event tracking, and experimentation while enabling teams to make confident, data-informed decisions.
   

  

 Your insights will directly influence the experience of millions of consumers and thousands of professionals using Bokadirekt every month.
   

  

 Beyond product analytics, we're looking for someone with an AI-native mindset—someone who knows how to leverage AI to work smarter while applying sound judgement to validate AI-generated insights and recommendations. This is an opportunity to shape how analytics, experimentation, and AI contribute to the continued growth of one of Sweden's most widely used consumer platforms.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Drive product insights across the full customer journey by identifying user behaviour, friction points, drop-offs, and growth opportunities
* Own A/B testing end-to-end, from experiment design and statistical validation to analysis and post-mortems
* Champion our experimentation framework by coaching product managers, designers, and engineers on experiment design and data-informed decision-making
* Collaborate with Product and Engineering teams to define, implement, and continuously improve reliable event tracking standards
* Leverage AI tools to accelerate analysis, improve productivity, and apply sound judgement when validating AI-generated insights


**Who You Are**
* Degree in Business, Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, or a related field
* Proven experience (2–4 years) as a Product Analyst or Data Analyst, ideally in a technology-driven environment
* Strong proficiency in SQL
* Hands-on experience designing, analysing, and evaluating A/B tests
* Experience working with product event tracking in fast-moving environments where processes and data are continuously evolving
* Comfortable bringing structure to ambiguous situations and turning insights into action
* Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders
* Experience with GCP (BigQuery, Looker), Amplitude, Mixpanel, Confidence by Spotify or similar
* Professional fluency in English; Swedish is a plus


**What We Offer**
* The opportunity to influence product strategy and user experience through data at one of Sweden's most widely used consumer apps
* The opportunity to shape how product decisions are made through experimentation, analytics, and AI
* A collaborative culture built on ownership, innovation, and knowledge sharing
* A flexible hybrid work model with four days in the office each week, including Wednesdays as our "Inspiration Day," when the whole company comes together for breakfast and shared activities
* A modern office in the heart of Stockholm
* A competitive salary and benefits package


**About The Position**
 Start date: As soon as possible / By agreement
   

  

 Location: Our office at Kungsgatan 38 in central Stockholm (hybrid)
   

  

 Employment type: Full-time, permanent position
   

  

 Application deadline: August 14
   

  

**Application**
 We review applications continuously, and the position may be filled before the application deadline. We therefore encourage you to apply as soon as possible.
   

  

 Summer is here, and we are also taking some time to recharge. During the holiday period, our response times may be slightly longer than usual, and the recruitment process will resume from week 32.
   

  

 Thank you for your patience. We wish you a wonderful summer and hope to hear from you soon!

title: Game Artist
description:
***Do you want to be part of creating fantastic, unique and entertaining iGaming experiences in a competitive global market?We are looking for a talented Game Artist with a strong passion for bringing life, entertainment and excitement to our growing games portfolio.***




***ELK is a leading developer in the iGaming industry, known for our innovative, visually stunning, and critically acclaimed game titles and IPs. We push the boundaries of gameplay and visual fidelity, setting new standards in the iGaming world.***




  





**About the role** 




 We take great pride in creating and offering our players a wide range of different art styles and themes in our games. As a Game Artist, you’ll take on the exciting challenge of transforming early concept art into pixel-perfect final assets, while also crafting original concepts and artwork from the ground up.
 



  





 A typical work week as an Game Artist can consist of:
 



  





**Asset Creation:** 
 Craft a diverse array of high-quality 2D game assets, UI element designs and awesome, polished headlines (typography) prepared for seamless handover to our expert animators. Your sharp eye for composition, color, perspective, and lighting will be critical in ensuring the highest standard of work.
 



  





**Collaborate Across Disciplines:** 
 Work closely with other artists, animators and programmers to collaboratively build “best in class” iGames.
 



  





**Communication:** 
 Partner with the Art Director and Creative Director to follow the unique art style of each game. Be open to feedback and take the initiative to independently enhance and perfect your work, while still ensuring it aligns with the creative vision.
 



  





**Innovation:** 
 Push the boundaries of what is possible in the realms of iGames to create visually stunning and memorable experiences.
 



  





**Qualifications** 




  





**Experience:** 
 Minimum of 2 years of experience creating 2D assets with focus on mobile within the gaming or similar industry.
 



  





**Polishing & UI Expertise:** 
 Skilled at polishing game assets to perfection, ensuring every detail shines and aligns with the creative vision. Experienced in creating intuitive UI elements that enhance the player experience, seamlessly combining functionality with captivating design.
 



  





**Software skills:** 
 Strong knowledge of Photoshop. Knowledge in 3D is a big plus but not required.
 



  





**Portfolio:** 
 A captivating portfolio demonstrating excellent artistic ability including the effective use of color, composition, and typography.
 



  





**Creativity:** 
 A passion for art and a sharp eye for detail are essential, along with the ability to adapt to various art styles. Your understanding of animation will be crucial, as you’ll help create assets ready for seamless animation.
 



  





**Passion for Gaming:** 
 A passion for video games and an understanding of what makes them visually engaging and immersive.
 



  





**Language:** 
 The ideal candidate will possess excellent English language skills, both in written and verbal communication, as this is essential for daily tasks and collaboration. Proficiency in Swedish is a plus but not required.
 



  





**We offer** 




  





 An ever-changing opportunity to explore different art styles, concepts, and themes together with highly skilled creatives in various crafts. Our project cycles are short, and you will be able to thrive in your creativity and passion by creating a range of visually stunning, unforgettable iGaming experiences.
 



  





 We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees, where everyone is respected, valued, and empowered to succeed.
 



  





 We work on-site at our awesome office, 2 minutes from T-Centralen in Stockholm.
 



 Fill in an application below and please include your portfolio and CV.
 



  





 For the right candidate, the recruitment process includes: interviews (digitally and at our studio), as well as a work assignment. We will fill the position as soon as we have found the right candidate, so do not hesitate to submit your application as soon as possible.
 



  





 Please note that our Talent Acquisition team will be taking a small summer break during the month of July. The selection will be paused during this period.

title: Project Manager
description:
**Who are Benifex?** 
 💚💜
 



  





 We are a fast-moving technology company, and
 **one of the most successful providers of online reward and employee benefits solutions in the world.** 
 We believe that everyone deserves an exceptional experience at work, every day, and build
 **workplace technology** 
 that makes this happen. Benifex’s mission is to
 **build remarkable experiences that employees love.** 
 Today Benifex supports more than five million employees in over 3,000 organisations across more than 100 countries. To help us on our quest to be the best,
 **we need brilliant people** 
 on board and that’s where you come in. 🚀
 



  





**Why should you apply? 🌟** 



* Be part of a Delivery team where customer satisfaction and user adoption are at the heart of everything we do.
* Join a collaborative and supportive team that makes work both rewarding and enjoyable.
* Thrive in a highly customer-centric environment where you contribute to delivery success and client satisfaction while developing your project management skills.
* Work closely with cross-functional experts across a hybrid Agile and Waterfall delivery model.
* Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives and help shape how Benifex delivers world-class implementation projects.



  





**Great Benefits** 




 ⚖️ Work-life balance with a hybrid working model.
 



 🧠 ITP1 pension.
 



 ❤️ Lifeplan - a leading financial advisory service that offers personalized advice for maximizing your pension savings.
 



 📝 Collective agreement.
 



 💸 Access to our comprehensive benefits portal.
 



 🤸 Generous wellness allowance.
 



 ✈️ 30 vacation days / year.
 



 💰 Referral bonuses.
 



 🌟 Enhanced parental pay.
 



 🙂 Volunteer Days – two paid days annually to give back to the community.
 



  





**Role Overview 🚀** 




 This role is well suited for someone early in their project management career who is looking to develop their skills in a structured, supportive environment.
 



 As a Project Manager within the Nordics Project Management team, you will be responsible for delivering high-quality implementations of Benifex solutions, ensuring projects are completed on time, within budget, and aligned with customer needs. You will support and manage a portfolio of concurrent projects, with guidance from experienced colleagues, from initiation through to delivery and user adoption. As the primary point of contact for customers throughout the implementation journey, you will play a key role in driving successful outcomes while maintaining a strong focus on quality, accountability, and continuous improvement.
 



  





**Responsibilities 🤘** 



* Manage multiple concurrent implementation projects across varying levels of complexity.
* Deliver projects against agreed scope, timelines, and budget.
* Take full end-to-end ownership of project delivery and outcomes.
* Act as the primary point of contact for customers, setting and managing expectations.
* Identify and resolve misalignment between customer needs and agreed scope.
* Coordinate cross-functional project delivery teams (configuration, content, integrations) without formal line management.
* Proactively identify risks, mitigate issues, and maintain clear project reporting (RAG status, timelines, budgets, risks).
* Contribute to continuous improvement by sharing lessons learned and helping to enhance delivery processes.



  





**What are we looking for? 🔎** 



* 2+ years of experience in project management.
* Experience delivering software implementation projects (SaaS experience is a plus).
* Basic understanding of APIs, system integrations, and system configuration.
* Comfortable interacting with customers, building relationships, and communicating effectively with stakeholders.
* Understanding of customer needs and pain points, with the ability to deliver accordingly.
* Familiarity with both Agile and Waterfall methodologies.
* Strong ownership mindset with a focus on delivery quality and outcomes.
* Highly structured, organised, and proactive approach to work.
* Strong collaboration skills and ability to coordinate work across project teams.
* Experience with Jira or equivalent project management tools.
* Eagerness to learn and develop within project management.
* Fluency in Swedish and English.



  





**Our interview process** 




**✌** 
 Benifex understands the need to have a fast and efficient process, the below will all be completed in the shortest time possible.
 



 📞 Initial call with the Talent team
 



 ⏳ Interview with the hiring manager
 



 ⏳ Case presentation
 



 🤩 Final interview with a senior team member.
 



  





 Please submit your CV in English. We are looking forward to reading your application!
 



*Please let us know if you need any reasonable adjustments for interviews by replying to the email you will receive after you apply.*

title: Partner Solution Architect, Regional System Integrators
description:
**Minimum qualifications:**
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 6 years of experience with cloud native architecture in a customer-facing or support role.
* Experience in public cloud architecture, including compute, networking, Identity and Access Management (IAM), and microservices.
* Experience in pre-sales acceleration, technical proofs-of-concept (PoCs), and leading technical workshops.


**Preferred qualifications:**
* Deep Domain Specialization (AI, Data, or Infrastructure), expert-level depth in at least ONE domain.
* Experience in enterprise technology buying and evaluation processes paired with an understanding of computing solutions, and the business-to-technology translation skills to challenge partner delivery strategies.
* Ability to deliver results and work cross-functionally alongside direct Google Cloud Platform Customer Engineers to position and orchestrate a solution consisting of multiple products.
* Ability to drive and influence Partner Tech audiences, identify expansion engagements within partner accounts, and ensure accelerated velocity with zero partner-delivery escalations on Partner-led delivery deals .


**About The Job**
 The Google Cloud Platform team helps customers transform and build what's next for their business — all with technology built in the cloud. Our products are developed for security, reliability and scalability, running the full stack from infrastructure to applications to devices and hardware. Our teams are dedicated to helping our customers — developers, small and large businesses, educational institutions and government agencies — see the benefits of our technology come to life. As part of an entrepreneurial team in this rapidly growing business, you will play a key role in understanding the needs of our customers and help shape the future of businesses of all sizes use technology to connect with customers, employees and partners.
   

  

 As a Partner Solution Architect, you will serve as the pre-sales solution design authority for our priority Regional System Integrators and strategic partners across EMEA.
   

  

 As a part of this role, you will operate strictly ring-fenced from Global System Integrator engagements, you are the ecosystem co-pilot to Google Cloud's Account Platform Customer Engineers, where the Account Platform CE owns the direct customer relationship and strategy, you own your partner's technical capability to successfully deliver it. You will move seamlessly from regional advisory to deep, domain-specific execution (AI, Data, or Infrastructure) to capture the pre-sales gap, while ruthlessly deflecting post-sales delivery.
   

  

 You will work in close collaboration with the Partner Development Managers responsible for the RSIs and Strategic Partners in your sub-region to create, drive and execute a joint business plan successfully, focusing on most impactful engagements across your sub-region and contribute to Partner Community in your domain of expertise.
   

  

 Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.
   

  

 Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
   

  

 Sweden: kr1040000 - kr1060000 (SEK) + 42.86% bonus target + equity + benefits
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 Learn more about benefits at Google .
   

  

* Drive VIP, "Red-Carpet" bootcamps and hackathons for partners to accelerate sales cycles and to ensure high-quality on time delivery, driving a successful path to consumption.
* Provide targeted pre-sales architectural support exclusively for RSIs and strategic partners in South, acting as a technical peer to Account CEs to unblock complex deals or customize partner activation, while leading the tech review and validation of highest impact Statements of Work (SoWs) to ensure a strict path to production and secure Partner funding Return on Investment (ROI).
* Serve as the regional pre-sales design authority by authoring baseline enterprise replicable assets ( functional AI demos for example) and leading deep-dive technical sessions and hackathons for the regional Partner Tech Community to broadcast enablement 1-to-many.
* Contribute actively to building, running and maintaining EMEA Partner Tech Community.


 Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form .

title: Solution Architect
description:
**About Applied Intuition**
 Applied Intuition, Inc. is powering the future of physical AI. Founded in 2017 and now valued at $15 billion, the Silicon Valley company is creating the digital infrastructure needed to bring intelligence to every moving machine on the planet. Applied Intuition services the automotive, defense, trucking, construction, mining and agriculture industries in three core areas: tools and infrastructure, operating systems, and autonomy. Eighteen of the top 20 global automakers, as well as the United States military and its allies, trust the company’s solutions to deliver physical intelligence. Applied Intuition is headquartered in Sunnyvale, California, with offices in Washington, D.C.; San Diego; Ft. Walton Beach, Florida; Ann Arbor, Michigan; London; Stuttgart; Munich; Stockholm; Bangalore; Seoul; and Tokyo. Learn more at applied.co.
   

  

*We are an in-office company, and our expectation is that employees primarily work from their Applied Intuition office 5 days a week. However, we also recognize the importance of flexibility and trust our employees to manage their schedules responsibly. This may include occasional remote work, starting the day with morning meetings from home before heading to the office, or leaving earlier when needed to accommodate family commitments.*
 Meet our Solution Architects!
   

  

 Our Solution Architects (SA) act as the glue between our customers and our engineering teams. They are responsible for customer success and drive impact with high-priority customer engagements – hear from them on what life is like at Applied Intuition and what makes their roles so exciting!
   

  

**About The Role**
 (We are hiring for all levels of experience.)
   

  

 We are looking for bright software engineers interested in extending and adapting our products for Applied Intuition's global customers. Our Solution Architects have a unique mix of software expertise, domain knowledge, and an execution-driven mindset. Using these skills, our engineers work closely with autonomy developers to ensure that Applied Intuition's products are providing maximum impact to advance customers autonomy initiatives. This is an important role for the company, bringing together our product and engineering expertise with our customer-centric culture.
   

  

 Check out what a typical day would look like as a Solution Architect here!
   

  

**At Applied Intuition, You Will**
* Work closely with customers to understand their development needs and use cases for autonomy to propose effective use of Applied Intuition's products
* Collaborate with engineering teams to ensure the product roadmap enables current and prospective customers
* Ensure customer needs are supported by the broader engineering team through effective prioritization
* Collaborate with our sales team to gather requirements through detailed technical discussions and workshops
* Explore new product development areas driven by strategic understanding of the customer landscape


**We're Looking For Someone Who Has**
* Experience with interacting with end-customers as an application engineer or a developer
* Familiarity with best practices in large scale software development
* Strong communication skills and focus on solving customer problems


**Nice To Have**
* Prior background in technical sales or application engineering for simulation products
* Experience with automotive OEMs or suppliers
* Prior work in autonomous vehicle development domains
* Prior work in software simulation


**Benefits**
* 30 days of paid vacation per year
* Free daily lunch and dinner in the office, plus breakfast, snacks, and drinks
* Supplemental private health insurance (PrivatAccess Silver) — specialist appointments within 7 working days and surgery within 14, plus long-term sickness income insurance, premium waiver insurance, and group life insurance (TGL)
* Occupational pension: 4.5% of salary up to the statutory income ceiling and 30% of salary above it
* 9,360 SEK annual learning & development and 5,615 SEK annual fitness budget
* 25 free Lyra coaching or therapy sessions per year for you and each of your dependents
* Generous parental leave: on top of statutory parental leave


*Don’t meet every single requirement? If you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.*

Consequently, the parties agree that, as applicable, they will abide by the requirements of 41 CFR 60-1.4(a), 41 CFR 60-300.5(a) and 41 CFR 60-741.5(a) and that these laws are incorporated herein by reference. These regulations require that covered prime contractors and subcontractors take affirmative action to employ and advance in employment individuals without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status or disability. title: PAM AI Lead
description:
The
 **PAM AI Lead** 
 is a newly created role within the Player Account Management department, established to drive the execution of our #AI strategy. You will capture the AI needs of the organisation and ensure that our offering of tools, training, and best practices enables PAM to excel in an increasingly AI-driven landscape.
 



  





 In this role, you will lead the integration of AI into all aspects of our workflow, setting clear goals and KPIs and acting as the primary point of contact for all things AI — from tooling and exploration to new opportunities. By building and enabling a network of technical experts and AI ambassadors across PAM, you will provide hands-on support, organise training, trial new tools, and ensure best practices are widely shared.
 



  





**WHAT YOU WILL DO** 



* Be accountable for the execution of the #AI strategy in PAM, driving outcomes, adoption and continuous improvement
* Own the AI tool offering for PAM, ensuring the needs of the organisation are understood, documented and met with the right solutions
* Set goals and KPIs for AI usage and outcomes within PAM, tracking data on costs, adoption rates and productivity improvements
* Act as the primary point of contact for all AI-related questions and suggestions — both within PAM and across other Tech departments — driving common agendas and joint evaluations
* Build and enable a community of internal AI ambassadors and technical experts, fostering an AI-first culture that inspires, trains and supports all team members
* Run trials and assess new tools, maintaining market awareness and distinguishing between hype and realisable value
* Own a PAM catalogue of approved and recommended MCPs and Skills, keeping it current and relevant
* Safeguard AI tool usage in collaboration with Group Security, maintaining a healthy balance between productivity and security
* Organise Geek Sessions and other training initiatives to build AI capability across the department
* Collaborate cross-functionally with other Tech departments to share lessons learned and run joint efforts



  





**WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR** 



* Strong understanding of AI — its opportunities, risks and practical applications in a business context
* Data-driven mindset — comfortable setting metrics, tracking adoption and using evidence to drive decisions
* Market awareness — you keep a keen eye on AI developments and can separate meaningful trends from noise
* Stakeholder management — able to engage, influence and collaborate across teams at all levels
* Change leadership — comfortable driving cultural and operational change in a complex organisation
* Security-conscious — understands the trade-offs between productivity and risk, and navigates them confidently
* Highly organised — capable of managing multiple workstreams, priorities and stakeholders simultaneously
* Curious and proactive — always looking for the next opportunity to empower colleagues and improve outcomes



 #AIinBusiness #AIStrategy #Compliance&AI #AITools #AIbestpractices #AIchampion

title: Customer Success Manager
description:
**Oneflow är en allt-i-ett-plattform för avtal som hjälper företag att skapa, förhandla, signera och hantera avtal genom hela deras livscykel. Vi ersätter krångliga PDF:er och manuella processer med interaktiva digitala avtal som är utformade för att ge en smidigare kundupplevelse. Vi är börsnoterade och fortsätter att innovera med AI, och formar framtiden för automatisering av avtal.**
*Vi söker en Customer Success Manager som vill bli en del av vårt fantastiska team i Stockholm. Du kommer att arbeta som en engagerad och mångsidig Customer Success Manager med passion för att säkerställa att våra kunder får maximalt värde av vår plattform.*
**Vem du är**
 Du har hög empatisk förmåga och kan förstå samt relatera till kunders utmaningar och mål. En utmärkt kommunikatör som är skicklig på att bygga relationer och tydligt förmedla information. Proaktiv och kreativ problemlösare som alltid söker innovativa lösningar för att hjälpa kunder att lyckas. Naturligt organiserad och detaljorienterad. Driven och resultatinriktad – du strävar alltid efter att hjälpa kunder att nå sina mål och överträffa sina förväntningar.
   

  

**Dina arbetsuppgifter**
* Säkerställa att våra kunder får maximalt värde genom att vårda relationer med våra intressenter och beslutsfattare, med fokus på kunder i mid- & large segmentet
* Genomföra regelbundna uppföljningar som leder till förnyade avtal, expansion, ökad kundnöjdhet och upplevd ROI
* Fördjupa din produkt- och branschkunskap för att utbilda kunder i hur de bäst utnyttjar Oneflows funktioner samt introducera dem till nya produktuppdateringar
* Samarbeta nära med andra interna team för att säkerställa full produktanvändning genom att ta initiativ och agera på kundens behov och tillväxtmöjligheter
* Vara kundens röst och ge intern feedback om hur Oneflow kan stötta våra kunder ännu bättre.


**Kompetens och krav**
* Du har 2–3 års dokumenterad erfarenhet inom Customer Success, gärna från B2B- och SaaS-branschen.
* Utmärkta skriftliga och muntliga kommunikationsfärdigheter samt flytande svenska och engelska
* Tekniskt intresse och vana vid olika CRM-, HR- och ERP-system
* Stark arbetsmoral, självgående med förmåga att prioritera effektivt
* Empatisk, intellektuellt nyfiken och tycker om att interagera med människor samt coacha dem till framgång
* Kunskap i franska, nederländska eller tyska är meriterande.


**Vad vi erbjuder**
* Möjlighet att vara en del av en snabbväxande scale-up med en fantastisk kultur – vårt eNPS (medarbetarnas nöjdhetspoäng) ligger över branschens genomsnitt
* Arbeta i ett team med en tydlig vision, målsättningar och nyckelresultat
* Årligt friskvårdsbidrag på 5000 SEK
* Välutrustat kontor med snacks och drycker
* Veckovisa/månatliga aktiviteter baserade på vår kultur
* Försäkring och pensionsplan
* Högkvalificerade och inspirerande internationella kollegor
* Snabbrörlig, inkluderande och öppen arbetskultur
* Möjlighet att sätta ditt avtryck och skapa din egen karriärväg


**Känns detta som dig?**
 Skicka in ditt CV och ett personligt brev på engelska, där du berättar varför rollen lockar dig och varför du passar för den. Rollen kräver flytande svenska och engelska, men vårt rekryteringsteam hanterar processen på engelska.
   

  

**Vi återkommer till dig så snart som möjligt!**
 Vi värdesätter jämställdhet och mångfald och strävar efter ett team som speglar dagens samhälle. Vi är en mångfaldig arbetsplats med 100+ personer från 30+ olika nationaliteter, och vi tror att vår olikhet, både i bakgrund och erfarenheter, är en styrka för oss.
   

  

 Besök gärna vår hemsida för mer information om vår produkt. Besök vår blogg för mer information om vår kultur och dina framtida kollegor 💜
   

  

**En sak innan du ansöker!**
 Vi vill se den verkliga dig, inte AI-genererad text. Tänk inte för mycket, det viktigaste är dina egna ord och vem du är. Skriv från hjärtat. 💫
   

  

 Oneflow is a platform that automates the entire contract process from start to finish, all in one place. Turning clunky, static contracts into helpful, digital contracts.
   

  

 Processes are faster, decisions are better, and deals are quicker. It’s an easier, smoother, and smarter way for teams of all shapes and sizes to handle their contracts.

title: Senior Product Manager
description:
Shape how video advertising scales on the open web, where product meets commercial impact.
   

  

 Most ad budgets flow to a few closed platforms for one reason: they make it easy. Buying video on the open web should be just as easy. We are moving from a sales-led company to a product-led one, and you will help write the strategy that gets us there. This is a senior, high-agency role for someone who brings commercial instinct, product craft, and the conviction to decide what we stop doing.
   

  

**About SeenThis**
 The open web has massive untapped advertising potential, but video has historically underperformed here. SeenThis is changing that. As a video advertising partner, we prove the open web delivers exceptional results, capturing more attention with cost-effective video that keeps publishers profitable and the internet independent. Since 2017, we've served billions of streams for 5,000+ brands across 50+ countries. We believe brands deserve reach wherever audiences are, publishers deserve sustainable revenue, and the internet deserves to stay open.
   

  

 Our team of 130+ employees works globally from offices in Stockholm, Oslo, London, Paris, Singapore, Hong Kong, New York, and Sydney. We're expanding across all teams and constantly seeking new colleagues who want to make real impact in a fast-moving, collaborative environment where innovation happens daily.
   

  

 Do you want to be part of our journey, where we dare to discover, own it, and win together?
   

  

 Join SeenThis!
   

  

**About The Role**
 This is not a role where you inherit a fixed roadmap and keep it moving. You will help decide what should become a product, what should stay a service, what we should package differently, and what we should stop doing.
   

  

 SeenThis has strong commercial traction, deep customer relationships, and technology that works. The next step is turning years of bespoke campaign delivery into scalable products that brands and agencies can use at every level, from self-serve to fully managed, with our tools, services, and partner integrations running on the same core engine.
   

  

 You will lead product for a vital part of our growing suite, partnering closely with the CPTO, commercial leaders, engineers, designers, and data. You will own the outcome and the case for it: whether this is the right thing to build, whether customers adopt it, and whether it moves the business.
   

  

 Your initial focus will likely be sharpening Studio or Creative Manager into scalable product workflows. Studio is our creative production platform. Creative Manager supports the workflow from media plan to format specs to gathering creatives across many formats. As you learn the broader suite, you will help decide where product leadership should focus next.
   

  

 This is a senior individual contributor role, not a people-management one. It is high-agency and hands-on: you own a complex product area end to end. You will set direction, shape the roadmap, turn manual work into repeatable workflows, push back on bespoke work that does not scale, and broker the tradeoffs between commercial needs and product focus.
   

  

 The mandate is real and backed from the top. Decisions here weigh more than the next deal: whether something scales, serves the most customers, and helps commercial teams sell the value clearly. You will have backing, but not a blueprint.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Take the most commercially important problems, run the discovery that lowers the risk, and stay accountable for the outcome long after it ships.
* Move customer work from one-off delivery onto the product, so accounts can grow without a new round of manual effort every time.
* Shape how parts of the suite are packaged, priced, and positioned, so customers see the value, the field can sell it, and the business can scale it.
* Spend real time with customers and commercial teams, and turn what you learn into product decisions the team can act on.
* Work closely with engineering, design, and data to solve problems together, not by handing down specs.
* Find where AI can carry the load inside our products. Our workflows include many manual steps. You will decide which ones AI can draft, route, or automate, where human judgment still needs to sit, and how we measure quality so we ship features customers trust.
* Decide what we stop doing, with conviction.


**Qualifications**
* Senior product management experience in a commercial B2B environment.
* Direct exposure to pricing, packaging, monetisation, growth, go-to-market, or other commercial product decisions. This is the heart of the role.
* Commercial instinct you treat as your own problem, not someone else's. You care about willingness to pay, sales motion, segments, adoption, retention, and margin.
* A strong product toolbox: discovery, strategy, clear writing, close work with design and engineering, the right measures of success, strong launches, and learning from the market.
* Clear communication that brings people along, with strategy and tradeoffs open enough for others to challenge.
* Comfort working before the process exists. You bring structure without slowing the company down.
* Fluency using AI in your own work, from research and synthesis to prototyping and analysis. We will ask for concrete examples of how you already do this.


**Bonus If You Have Experience With**
* Building AI into a product itself, not just using it: judgment on where it should automate, where a human should stay in the loop, and whether the output is good enough to ship.
* Ad tech, martech, creative tools, media, or another commercially complex domain.
* Moving a company from service-heavy delivery to scalable product revenue.
* Building or shaping a product function early.
* Self-serve, usage-based, hybrid, or enterprise pricing.


**Application**
 As we review applications and interview on a continuous basis, please apply as soon as possible.
   

  

 Due to the high volume of applications received, we are unable to provide personalized feedback prior to the interview stage. Thank you for understanding!
   

  

**Please note:** 
 we're in our summer holiday period. Response times may be a little longer than usual, and we will get back to all candidates with feedback once the holiday period is over. Thank you for your understanding and patience!
   

  

 We conduct background checks on all SeenThis-hires to comply with our customers and protect business-critical information.
   

  

 We look forward to welcoming you to SeenThis!
   

  

 Status Quo-what? With courage and curiosity, we explore the unknown in the quest for game-changing-impact.
   

  

 To us, ownership is more than just another buzzword. It's our driving force. We own our projects and nurture them from idea to reality.
   

  

 To us, it's essential to forge deep connections both within SeenThis and with our clients. And, we approach every challenge and celebrate each success as a unified team
   

  

 The open web represents the internet's greatest untapped advertising opportunity. While 61% of consumer time happens here, across premium publishers, diverse voices, and independent content, only 29% of ad budgets follow. SeenThis is changing that.
   

  

 Our proprietary adaptive streaming technology proves the open web can outperform walled gardens, delivering 70% more attention and exceptional campaign results for brands while keeping publishers profitable and the internet independent.
   

  

 Since 2017, we've served over 40 billion impressions for 5,000+ brands across 50+ countries, partnering with agencies and publishers from eight offices worldwide.
   

  

 Brands deserve reach wherever their audiences are, publishers deserve sustainable revenue, and the internet deserves to stay open and thriving. SeenThis unlocks the open web's full potential. For more information, visit www.seenthis.co

title: Data Scientist, Pricing
description:
**TL;DR** 
 — You own the data behind how Lovable prices and packages. You turn usage, cost, and willingness-to-pay data into pricing and packaging bets, run the experiments to test them, and build the models that tell us what a change does to revenue and retention.
   

  

**Why Lovable?**
 Lovable lets anyone and everyone build software with any language. From solopreneurs to Fortune 100 teams, millions of people use Lovable to transform raw ideas into real products, fast. We are at the forefront of a foundational shift in software creation, which means you have an unprecedented opportunity to change the way the digital world works. Lovable-built applications and websites are visited hundreds of millions of times a month, and our enterprise footprint is compounding fast. And we're just getting started.
   

  

 We're a small, talent-dense team building a generation-defining company from Stockholm. We value extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We seek out people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world.
   

  

**What We're Looking For**
* Commercially-minded owner: A data scientist who owns pricing and packaging outcomes. You find the opportunity, model it, test it, and drive the change.
* Economics fluency: Deep understanding of unit economics including LTV, margin, token and infrastructure cost, willingness to pay, discounting, and subscription or credit models.
* Technical rigor: Strong SQL, Python, applied statistics, and experimentation skills. You are comfortable with causal questions where a clean A/B test is not always possible.
* Systems builder: You build the systems that price and package, such as discounting or packaging models that run on user records, rather than just delivering one-off analyses.
* Strategic judgment: An instinct for the tradeoff between growth and monetization, and the judgment to know when to prioritize each.
* Entrepreneurial spirit: You thrive with autonomy and enjoy working closely with finance, product, and growth teams.


**What You'll Do**
* Own the analytics behind pricing and packaging: what we charge, how we package it, and the impact of changes on revenue, conversion, and retention.
* Build models for unit economics, willingness to pay, and price sensitivity, translating them into concrete pricing bets.
* Design and execute pricing and packaging experiments, and act decisively on the results.
* Build the systems that operationalize pricing decisions, such as personalized discounting based on user records.
* Collaborate with finance, product, and growth to sequence and ship pricing changes effectively.


**Our tech stack**
 We're building with tools that both humans and AI love:
   

  

* Languages: SQL and Python
* Warehouse & events: BigQuery, PubSub
* Analytics & product: Hex, Lovable Apps
* Experimentation: A/B and growth testing
* Cloud: GCP


 And we are always on the lookout for what's next.
   

  

**How We Hire**
* Fill in a short form and jump on an intro call with our recruiting team
* A call with the hiring manager
* A take-home case study
* A Most Impressive Project session
* Cross-functional interviews with the people you'd work with
* A final conversation with leadership


**About Your Application**
 Please submit your application in English. It's our company language, so you'll be speaking it daily if you join.
   

  

 We treat all candidates equally. If you're interested, please apply through our careers portal.

title: Product Planner - 2027 Graduates
description:
**Job Description**

 This opportunity is designed only for applications of students graduating in 2027 who are looking to start their career at H&M after graduation.
   

  





 If you’re not graduating in 2027, don’t worry—another opportunity to join us as a Product Planner within Assortment will be published after the summer.
   

  





**Do you want to be part of creating the best customer offer, driving profitable growth and strengthening our customer offer? Are you looking for a role where your analysis and actions really make a difference? Then this is the opportunity for you!**




  

  

 H&M Assortment is a dynamic international workplace where high pace and rapid changes are natural parts of our day. This is where we design and develop our fashion collections for a wide variety of customers all over the world. H&M Assortment work cross-functional in diverse teams to create H&M’s best customer offer and experience – making it possible for everyone to look and feel good in a sustainable way.
   

  





**WHAT YOU’LL DO**




 You will constantly follow, react and identify new sales opportunities based on selling, customer insights and surrounding analysis. With strong analytical skills, a commercial mindset, and salesmanship, you ensure the right assortment impact across regions to maximise growth and profitability. Analysing the selling data of our products and optimise the assortment planning and quantification on your category.
   

  





 Acting in line with H&M values, you will drive the income and quantification strategy for your category through cross-functional collaboration, working closely with a business controller and having a close collaboration with other teams including pattern makers, designers, and product developers. You will drive and ensure that our global assortment is locally relevant and optimised for each region.
   

  





**Key Responsibilities:**




 Responsible to optimise the best regional customer offer by using quantification and sales analysis, leveraging customer and competitors’ insights.
   

  




* Understanding our customers and their demands for long- and short-term actions. Identify risks and opportunities from a planning perspective based on the set assortment strategy per region. Support the Business Controller in driving regional strategy through quantification, planning, and structured follow-up.
* With a curious and driven selling mindset, conduct sales analysis of our products to identify patterns and translate them into actionable conclusions with the aim to make an impact and maximise the totality.
* Manage and optimise stock flow between regions and channels, taking responsibility for effective moves, transitions and securing order placement. Involving our Production offices in the process when needed.
* Demonstrate salesmanship & urgency for outcome. Bring a solution-oriented, positive, and agile mindset to change and complexity, driving clear action focus and follow-through.
* Create best collaboration with the team and relevant stakeholders.



**WHO YOU ARE**




*We are looking for people with:*



* Degree within business related areas, textile fashion or a equivalent area
* Strong analytical skills and the ability to turn your analysis into actions
* Business and commercial mindset
* Strong communication skills
* Fluent in English, both written and verbally
* Experience from planning, merchandising, buying, or purchasing is meriting
* Experience within e-commerce is meritorious



*And people who are:*



* Self-motivated and take ownership to learn and to seek opportunities to improve ways of working.
* Demonstrate curiosity, initiative, and a passion for continuously refining planning and quantification methods.
* Have a strong business sense by prioritizing time and effort based on potential business impact, focusing on actions that deliver the greatest value and will make the biggest difference.
* Communicating with impact and seeing patterns in our data.
* Engaging team player and self-motivated to drive goals and thrive in an entrepreneurial setting.



**JOIN US**




 This is a fulltime position based in our office in Stockholm, Sweden. You don’t have to live in Sweden already, we welcome applications from all parts of the world and offer relocation support if needed.
   

  





 Apply by sending in your CV in English as soon as possible. Due to data policies, we only accept applications through career page.
   

  





**WHY YOU’LL LOVE WORKING HERE**




 At H&M Group, we are proud to be a vibrant and welcoming company. We offer our employees attractive benefits with extensive development opportunities around the globe.
   

  




* All our employees receive a staff discount card, usable on all our H&M Group brands in stores and online. Brands covered by the discount are H&M (Beauty and Move included), COS, Weekday, Monki, H&M HOME, & Other Stories, ARKET and Afound
* In addition to our staff discount, all our employees are included in our H&M Incentive Program – HIP



 Our uniqueness comes from a combination of many things – our inclusive and collaborative culture, our strong values, and opportunities for growth. But most of all, it’s our people who make us who we are.
   

  





 Take the next step in your career together with us. The journey starts here.
   

  





*\*We are committed to a recruitment process that is fair, equitable, and based on competency. We therefore kindly ask you to not attach a cover letter in your application.*




**WHO WE ARE**




 H&M Group is a global company of strong fashion brands and ventures. Our goal is to prove that there is no compromise between exceptional design, affordable prices, and sustainable solutions. We want to liberate fashion for the many, and our customers are at the heart of every decision we make.
   

  





 We are made up of thousands of passionate and talented colleagues united by our shared culture and values. Together, we want to use our power, our scale, and our knowledge to push the fashion industry towards a more inclusive and sustainable future.
   

  





*To ensure we provide an insightful experience to our candidates, and we support their understanding of the role scope and responsibilities for this role, we use an online assessment method for skills-based recruitment with our recruitment processes. You will need to complete it as part of the application and screening process. Your responses will be scored by an assessment tool that applies predefined criteria set by H&M Group.*




*After completing the assessment, you will receive feedback with the score you obtained. If you experience any difficulties or prefer an alternative assessment method, please contact recruitment\_support@hm.com. Choosing an alternative will not impact your application. For more information on how we process your personal data, please see our Privacy Notice.*

title: Senior Director, People Operations
description:
**About Us**
 Legora is redefining how legal work gets done. Not built for lawyers, built with them. We work alongside the world’s best legal teams, who expect excellence, precision, and speed, and we hold ourselves to the same bar.
   

  

 Our AI-native workspace lets legal professionals move faster, think more clearly, and operate with sharper precision. By analysing thousands of documents in minutes and powering end-to-end workflows, we cut through complexity, teams can focus on what matters: judgment, strategy, and outcomes.
   

  

 1,000+ customers across 50+ countries trust us, including Cleary Gottlieb, Goodwin, Linklaters, White & Case, Dentons, and Barclays. We’ve scaled to
 **$100M+ in ARR** 
 , with teams across Europe, North America and APAC, and continue to expand through acquisitions including Qura, Walter AI and Graceview.
   

  

 We partner with world-class performers: including Aaron Judge and the New York Yankees, Ludvig Åberg (and his caddie), and campaigns featuring Jude Law.
   

  

 Joining Legora means three things.
   

  

* We lean in: ownership over titles, outcomes over intentions.
* We fight for excellence: high standards, direct, ego-free feedback.
* We grow together: as a team and with our customers.


 Mission before ego. Everyone contributes. No one coasts.
   

  

 If you’re driven by impact, pace, and raising the bar. This is the place.
   

  

**The Role**
 Legora grew from 40 to 600 people in 18 months across Europe, the US, and APAC. The next phase is 1,500.
   

  

 You'll design the programs that shape how people join, grow, and perform here: onboarding, performance, manager development, and market expansion support, each one built from the ground up.
   

  

 You'll lead a team of five and growing, and report into the VP of People. The company is at the point where the People programs you build will define the experience for the next thousand people who join.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Own onboarding end to end: the experience, the content, the logistics, and the measurement. Design for a company adding people fast across multiple time zones and legal entities, where the first few weeks set the tone.
* Build and run the performance framework. Define how Legora sets expectations, gives feedback, and makes promotion and pay decisions at scale. Partner with HRBPs to make sure it lands consistently across functions and geographies.
* Own manager development. Legora has grown its management layer quickly across multiple markets; this role builds the infrastructure to support and develop them. Design the programs, identify the gaps, and work with leaders to close them.
* Lead the People program workstream for market expansion. When Legora enters a new geography, this role owns the People side: onboarding localisation, policy adaptation, and the employee experience from day one.
* Partner with People Tech on the system and data layer that sits behind every program. Own the process design; let People Tech own the tooling.
* Build the operating rhythm across the People function: the cadences, the planning cycles, and the cross-functional touchpoints that keep a fast-moving People team coordinated.


**What You Bring**
* Experience building People programs in a company scaling through a similar headcount inflection point. You've designed onboarding and performance frameworks that scaled with the business and held up under pressure.
* A track record of leading manager development at scale. You understand what good management capability looks like at a fast-growing tech company and you've built programs to develop it.
* Experience supporting geographic expansion from a People perspective. New markets, new employment law, new employee experience challenges, you've navigated all of it before.
* Comfort working at the intersection of People programs, People Tech, and HRBPs, with a clear sense of how the functions connect and where the handoffs sit.
* A team leadership track record. You've managed and developed People professionals and have the appetite to build a function alongside a fast-moving business.


**Legora is an Equal Opportunity Employer**
 At Legora, we believe great teams are built on diversity of thought and experience. We’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer and committed to creating an inclusive, high-performance culture where everyone can do their best work. We welcome people of all backgrounds and don’t discriminate based on race, color, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.
   

  

 Compensation Range: $251.6K - $296K

title: IT-strateg till Hägersten-Älvsjö stadsdelsförvaltning
description:
Stockholm – vår huvudstad med miljoner drömmar, förväntningar och ambitioner. Vi jobbar för alla som lever här idag och i framtiden. Nu söker vi dig som vill tänka stort, nytt och annorlunda med oss – för stockholmarna.


Hägersten-Älvsjö är en av 11 stadsdelsförvaltningar i Stockholms stad med cirka 3000 medarbetare. I dag är vi ett av stadens största stadsdelsområden med ca 130 000 invånare. I Hägersten-Älvsjö har du nära till staden, kommunikationer och naturen. Vi erbjuder en dynamisk arbetsplats med möjligheter för dig att utvecklas i din roll.

### **Välkommen till oss**


Hos oss får du möjlighet att vara med och forma en helt ny roll i en växande IT-funktion. Enheten för service och lokaler utvecklar nu sitt arbete inom digitalisering och informationsförvaltning, där vi vill skapa ännu bättre stöd till verksamheterna. Vi är en organisation där det är högt i tak, nära till beslut och där samarbete mellan verksamhet och IT är avgörande för att lyckas. Rollen som IT-strateg är ny och du får därför en viktig möjlighet att påverka både uppdragets innehåll och hur vi arbetar framåt.


Du blir en del av en mindre IT-grupp som idag består av tre IT-samordnare, där du kompletterar och stärker helheten i vårt digitaliseringsarbete.

### **Vi erbjuder dig**


Vi erbjuder en utvecklande roll i en verksamhet som befinner sig i en förändrings- och digitaliseringsresa. Här får du möjlighet att arbeta verksamhetsnära med stor påverkan på hur digitala lösningar utformas och används.


Du får:

* En nyckelroll i att bygga upp och utveckla IT- och digitaliseringsfunktionen
* Möjlighet att arbeta nära verksamheten och bidra till samhällsnytta
* En flexibel och samarbetsinriktad arbetsmiljö med engagerade kollegor
* Goda möjligheter till kompetensutveckling
* Förmåner såsom flextid och friskvårdsbidrag. Läs mer om våra förmåner här.

**Hälsning från din framtida chef**


”Hej! Mitt namn är Robin och jag är chef för enheten för service och lokaler.


Jag har ett lugnt och lyhört ledarskap och tror på att vi lyckas bäst tillsammans. Hos oss är det högt i tak, vi samarbetar nära och stöttar varandra i vardagen.


Jag söker dig som är serviceinriktad, prestigelös och gillar att lösa problem. Här får du en varierad roll med många kontaktytor och möjlighet att göra skillnad.”

### **Din roll**


Som IT-strateg arbetar du i gränslandet mellan verksamhet och IT och är en central länk i förvaltningens digitaliseringsarbete. Du har en strategisk och rådgivande roll där du driver och samordnar utvecklingen av digitala arbetssätt och lösningar.


Rollen är nyinrättad och du får möjlighet att vara med och forma arbetssätt, strukturer och processer för framtidens digitaliseringsarbete. Du arbetar både strategiskt och långsiktigt, samtidigt som du är nära verksamheten i det dagliga arbetet.


Dina huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter:

* Leda och stödja implementering av pm3-förvaltningsmodell utifrån våra behov och förutsättningar
* Fungera som objektägare IT för utvalda system
* Driva och samordna digitaliseringsinitiativ inom förvaltningen
* Säkerställa att stadens digitaliseringsprocesser efterlevs och utvecklas
* Vara en brygga mellan verksamheter och IT-funktioner
* Identifiera och bidra till digitalisering av processer inom exempelvis äldreomsorg och socialtjänst
* Bidra till informationssäkerhetsarbete och efterlevnad av relevanta regelverk, exempelvis cybersäkerhetslagstiftning
* Samverka med interna IT-samordnare och externa aktörer


Rollen innebär inget personalansvar men ett tydligt ansvar för samordning, utveckling och förändringsledning inom digitaliseringsområdet.


Du tillhör enheten för service och lokaler och arbetar nära våra tre IT-samordnare.

### **Din kompetens och erfarenhet**


Vi söker dig som har ett starkt intresse för hur digitalisering kan bidra till verksamhetsutveckling och som trivs i en roll där du får kombinera strategi, samordning och förändringsarbete.


För att lyckas i rollen har du:

* akademisk utbildning inom IT, systemvetenskap eller motsvarande erfarenhet som arbetsgivaren bedömer likvärdig
* erfarenhet av att driva digitaliserings- eller verksamhetsutvecklingsarbete
* kunskap om informationssäkerhet och cybersäkerhetsområdet
* mycket god förmåga att uttrycka dig på svenska i tal och skrift.


Det är meriterande om du har:

* certifiering inom ISO 27001 Lead
* erfarenhet av digitaliseringsarbete inom offentlig verksamhet
* kunskap om PM3
* erfarenhet från arbete inom Stockholms stad


Vi värdesätter följande personliga förmågor:  

Du är **initiativtagande** och trivs i en roll där du själv driver arbetet framåt och tar ansvar för att saker händer. Du är **utvecklingsinriktad** och har ett naturligt intresse för att förbättra arbetssätt, processer och digitala lösningar. Samtidigt arbetar du **strukturerat** och har förmåga att skapa ordning och tydlighet även i komplexa sammanhang. Du har ett **strategiskt** perspektiv och kan se långsiktiga konsekvenser och möjligheter i digitaliseringsarbetet. Rollen kräver att du är **självgående** och trygg i att fatta beslut och driva frågor utan att alltid ha färdiga ramar. Vi ser också att du har en god **helhetssyn**, där du förstår hur olika delar i verksamhet och IT hänger ihop och bidrar till organisationens gemensamma mål.

### **Övrigt**

**På grund av sommarledighet kommer möjligheten att besvara frågor om tjänsten att vara begränsad under delar av rekryteringsperioden. Urval påbörjas under vecka 35 och de första intervjuerna planeras att genomföras under vecka 36.**  

  

Vi rekryterar utan det personliga brevet i denna rekrytering för att stärka fokus på de kompetenser och erfarenheter som efterfrågas för denna roll.


Vi ser mångfald som berikande och välkomnar alla sökande.


Stockholms stad arbetar med kompetensbaserad rekrytering som syftar till att se till varje persons kompetens och därmed motverka diskriminering.

title: Lösningsarkitekt till Finansinspektionen
description:
Vad söker vi?
  
Vi söker en erfaren lösningsarkitekt för ett uppdrag hos Finansinspektionen. Rollen passar dig som har en bred teknisk förståelse och är van att omsätta verksamhetsbehov, krav och övergripande arkitektur till hållbara och konkreta IT-lösningar.
  
Om uppdraget
  
Finansinspektionen bedriver ett myndighetsövergripande arbete med att utveckla, leverera och förvalta IT-tjänster och datadrivna lösningar som stödjer verksamhetens behov.
  
Arbetet omfattar bland annat IT-strategi, IT-arkitektur, IT- och cybersäkerhet, digitalisering, innovation, projektsamordning och internationell IT-koordinering.
  
En viktig del av uppdraget är att effektivisera, digitalisera och automatisera verksamhetsprocesser och dataleveranser. Kvalitetssäkrad data ska göras tillgänglig för bland annat datadriven tillsyn, analys, AI och tillsynsteknologi, även kallat SupTech.
  
Som lösningsarkitekt får du en central roll i att säkerställa att tekniska lösningar möter verksamhetens behov, följer myndighetens arkitekturprinciper och kan utvecklas och förvaltas över tid.
  
Dina huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter
  
  

**I rollen kommer du bland annat att:**  

säkerställa att IT-lösningar utformas och realiseras utifrån verksamhetens krav och i samspel med myndighetens övriga IT-miljö
  
  

säkerställa att lösningarna har en lämplig livslängd och är möjliga att utveckla, förvalta och avveckla på ett strukturerat sätt
  
  

följa myndighetsövergripande arkitekturprinciper, standarder och riktlinjer
  
  

identifiera möjligheter till återanvändning av befintliga tjänster och funktioner
  
  

säkerställa att lösningarna stödjer både det aktuella förändringsinitiativet och myndighetens långsiktiga strategier
  
  

arbeta nära verksamhetsarkitekter för att säkerställa att tekniska lösningar utgår från och integreras med verksamhetsarkitekturen
  
  

väga funktionella krav mot kvalitetsegenskaper som säkerhet, prestanda, skalbarhet, robusthet, flexibilitet och förvaltningsbarhet
  
  

ta fram beslutsunderlag för prioriteringar, tekniska vägval och nödvändiga kompromisser
  
  

genomföra och bidra till arkitekturgranskningar
  
  

dokumentera helhetslösningen genom exempelvis scenariobeskrivningar, logiska vyer, tjänstegränssnitt, processrealiseringar och informationsmodeller
  
  

bidra inom teknikarkitektur för att säkerställa en sammanhängande helhetslösning
  
  

ta fram målarkitekturer, referensarkitekturer och lösningsarkitekturer med hänsyn till kostnadseffektivitet.
  
  

Vi söker dig som har
  
bred teknisk kompetens och djup förståelse för hur sammanhängande IT-lösningar utformas
  
  

erfarenhet av att omsätta verksamhetskrav och målarkitektur till konkreta tekniska designval
  
  

god kunskap om integrationsmönster, informationsflöden, tjänstedesign, processdesign och regeldesign
  
  

förståelse för olika typer av teknik- och infrastrukturarkitekturer och hur dessa tillämpas
  
  

god kunskap om IT- och cybersäkerhet samt hur säkerhetskrav realiseras i tekniska lösningar
  
  

förståelse för utveckling, förvaltning och livscykelhantering av IT-lösningar
  
  

erfarenhet av att bedöma och hantera kvalitetsegenskaper som prestanda, säkerhet, skalbarhet, robusthet och flexibilitet
  
  

förmåga att leda arkitekturdialoger och skapa samsyn mellan verksamhet, utveckling, säkerhet och andra intressenter
  
  

förmåga att dokumentera arkitekturella vägval och tydligt kommunicera konsekvenser, risker och beroenden
  
  

förståelse för de generella, regulatoriska och legala krav som myndigheter behöver följa vid utveckling och förvaltning av IT-lösningar.
  
  

Personliga egenskaper
  
För att lyckas i rollen ser vi att du är analytisk, strukturerad och lösningsorienterad. Du har ett tydligt helhetsperspektiv och kan samtidigt sätta dig in i tekniska detaljer när det behövs.
  
Du är kommunikativ och van att föra dialog med både tekniska och verksamhetsnära intressenter. Du kan förklara komplexa tekniska frågor på ett tydligt sätt och har förmåga att driva arkitekturarbetet framåt även när det finns motstridiga krav, beroenden eller behov av kompromisser.

Through close collaboration across its engineering hubs, the client accelerates innovation, supports the development of world-class mobility solutions, and strengthens the group's global research and development capabilities.

Europe. You will play a crucial role in not only developing and deploying the latest data products on

satisfaction. Your expertise will guide and assist our stakeholders to access the necessary dataset
