title: Staff Software Engineer - Onsite Messaging
description:
We’re excited to welcome our first Staff Software Engineer to the newly forming Onsite Messaging team at Voyado.
   

  

 Onsite Messaging (OSM) is one of Voyado’s most important customer engagement channels. Instead of communicating through email or SMS, OSM enables retailers to engage customers directly on their websites with personalized experiences based on real-time behavior. Every interaction can be measured, understood and optimized, making OSM a key part of creating seamless customer journeys.
   

  

 We’re now bringing OSM onto Voyado’s Engage platform, and this role will play a central part in making that happen. You’ll join at the beginning of that journey, helping shape both the technical direction and the engineering practices while building a brand-new team in Stockholm together with colleagues in India.
   

  

**About The Role**
 This is a Staff Engineer role for someone who enjoys leading through technology.
   

  

 You'll act as the technical driver for Onsite Messaging. The frontend is moving into Voyado's Engage platform, while the backend continues to run and evolve on AWS — so you'll own both sides of that seam and make sure it holds together well. The transition is one chapter, not the job description. Although the role comes with significant technical ownership, it remains deeply hands-on. You’ll write code, review code, challenge architectural decisions and help the team make sound engineering choices every day.
   

  

 Initially, much of the focus will be understanding the existing solution, reviewing code and working closely with our engineering team in India as knowledge and ownership gradually move to Stockholm. As the transition progresses, your focus will shift towards driving the technical roadmap, enabling new product development and shaping the future Onsite platform.
   

  

 Onsite Messaging also sits on a shared JavaScript foundation that several Voyado products load on retailer sites. Getting that foundation into good shape — as a platform other teams can build on — is part of this role.
   

  

 Who you are
   

  

 We're looking for someone operating at around 8-10 years of engineering experience, who has been the person other engineers turn to on hard system design questions.
   

  

 You don’t need experience from our exact technology stack, but we believe you’ve worked with several of the following:
   

  

* Modern backend development in C#, .NET (out tech stack), or Comfortable moving between languages; Java, Kotlin, Go or similar
* JavaScript and TypeScript, with experience working across both frontend and backend when needed
* AWS, and serverless architecture in particular — our backend runs on that. Experience with Azure or GCP equivalents is fine if you're happy to work in AWS
* Distributed systems, scalable web applications and high-traffic products
* System design, software architecture and large technical migrations
* CI/CD, observability, automated testing and engineering best practices


 We also think you:
   

  

* have successfully led complex technical initiatives or migration projects
* enjoy reviewing code and helping other engineers grow
* communicate confidently across teams, cultures and technical disciplines
* thrive in environments where not everything has been defined yet
* enjoy collaborating with distributed engineering teams
* use AI coding tools as a natural part of software development and know how to review and quality-assure AI-generated code


**High Impact. Great People. Real Growth.**
 You’ll join a company with strong momentum, modern technology, and a collaborative culture where ideas and initiatives are encouraged.
   

  

 At Voyado, we care about creating an environment where people can grow, collaborate, and enjoy the journey together. We move quickly, challenge ideas, and work closely across teams to deliver meaningful impact.
   

  

**Some of our benefits:**
* 30 days of vacation
* Wellness allowance
* Personal development opportunities
* Summits and team activities
* Four days from the office and one day from home


**About Voyado**
 Voyado is the Agentic Customer Experience Suite for retail.
   

  

 More than 500 retail brands across 100 markets use Voyado to unite CRM, loyalty, product discovery, e-commerce personalization, and retail media with retail-trained AI that acts on real-time shopper intent.
   

  

 By combining customer data with product intelligence, Voyado helps retailers deliver more relevant experiences across every channel — online and in-store. The result is more traffic, higher conversions, stronger customer relationships, and measurable business impact.
   

  

 We’re growing across Europe and are looking for people who want to help shape the future of retail technology.
   

  

 Ready to make an impact?
   

  

 Fantastic! 🎉
   

  

 Applying is easy — submit your LinkedIn profile or upload your resume. We’d love to hear what excites you about this role and what challenges you’re eager to take on. Be yourself, and let your passion shine through.
   

  

 Additional information
   

  

 As part of our recruitment process, we conduct a background check on the final candidate.
   

  

 Making it personal with AI
   

  

 We believe you’ll position yourself best for success in the interview process by being yourself, with support from AI where it makes sense. Later in the process, you may even be expected to use AI. At the end of the day, what matters is meeting you — the person behind the application.
   

  

 There is no such thing as a perfect candidate; we’re all human, so please bring your authentic self. Don’t let AI over-polish your CV or answers to the point where we can’t hear your real voice, because that’s what we care about most.
   

  

 Vacation period!
   

  

*As we are heading out for the vacation period, feedback on your application might take a little longer than usual. Don't hesitate to send in your application, though; we'll do our best in getting back to you as soon as possible! 🌴*
 In today’s hyper-competitive market, we help over 500 retail brands across 100 markets attract, convert, and retain loyal customers.
   

  

 With AI-driven CRM, loyalty, e-commerce personalization, and retail media, Voyado turns every interaction - online or in-store - into lasting growth.
   

  

 By combining customer data with product intelligence, we empower retailers to deliver the right message, product, or offer at exactly the right time. The result? Stronger customer relationships and measurable business impact.

title: Senior Backend Engineer
description:
**Be a part of the next big thing**
 Do you thrive on tackling complex challenges? Are you passionate about creating impactful solutions that drive commerce forward? Are you someone who believes in encouraging and elevating those around you?
   

  

**About Us**
 Kustom, formerly known as Klarna Checkout (KCO), is the Nordic market leader in digital checkout solutions. Today, we support over 24,000 merchants across more than 170 countries, providing a streamlined checkout experience. We offer localized solutions in 18 markets, tailored to specific languages, currencies, and payment methods. No matter where your business operates, we deliver a checkout experience that meets the needs of both merchants and shoppers - driving growth globally. 🌍
   

  

**The role**
 We are looking to hire a Backend Engineer to join our development team. In this role, you will be responsible for designing and implementing robust server-side solutions using modern technologies and frameworks. You will work closely with product managers and fellow engineers to deliver high-performance, scalable applications that power our core business infrastructure.
   

  

 As an integral part of our development team, you'll play a crucial role in developing and maintaining our essential backend infrastructure. We need a detailed oriented person who can design and implement efficient, future-proof solutions for complex business problems. Your knowledge and vision will be instrumental in building a solid technical foundation that ensures our product remains reliable and performant as we grow.
   

  

 Here at Kustom, you'll get to drive innovation, and leave your mark on our technical architecture. As part of our cross-functional Agile team, you'll collaborate with talented peers to create digital products that revolutionize how merchants worldwide conduct their business.
   

  

 Our engineering teams are based in Stockholm, where we prioritize in-person collaboration at our office to foster strong team dynamics.
   

  

**Things you'll be doing**
* Implement scalable, high-performance backend services that power our global payment infrastructure
* Lead technical discussions and mentor junior team members while contributing to architectural decisions
* Drive engineering excellence through code reviews, best practices, and technical documentation
* Work closely with Product and Design to implement robust technical solutions
* Contribute to our technical roadmap and help shape the future of our platform


**Skills And Experience You'll Need**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
* 7+ years of professional experience in Backend development, with deep expertise in Java
* Strong track record of designing and implementing large-scale distributed systems
* Advanced knowledge of Spring Framework and Spring Boot
* Extensive experience with AWS cloud services and microservices architecture
* Expert-level understanding of database design, optimization, and various storage solutions
* Proven experience with Git and Github for version control and team collaboration
* Deep understanding of RESTful APIs, API security, and performance optimization


**We believe you'll thrive in this role if you have**
* Strong technical leadership skills with a track record of mentoring junior engineers
* Passion for solving complex engineering challenges and driving technical innovation
* Experience with high-throughput, low-latency systems is a plus
* Excellent communication skills and ability to explain complex technical concepts clearly
* Track record of driving technical initiatives and improving system architecture
* Strong commitment to code quality, testing, and technical documentation
* Ability to balance technical excellence with practical business needs


**Benefits**
* Comprehensive benefits package tailored to support your well-being and financial security
* Robust pension plan with national and occupational components
* Excellent health insurance coverage, including long-term illness protection and salary exchange options
* Annual wellness allowance of 3,000 SEK to invest in your health and fitness
* Extra day off when major holidays (e.g., Christmas Eve, New Year's Eve) fall on weekends
* Continuous learning opportunities and professional development support


**A place to grow**
 At Kustom, you’re not going to be just another face in the crowd. This is a place where we elevate each other and celebrate success as a team. We believe in our ability to create excellence — and have fun doing it!
   

  

 And we know we set high expectations, but we also know that the road to success isn’t a straight line. We support and encourage each other to try, to fail, to try again. Because that’s how we grow, individually and together.
   

  

 Does this sound like the place for you?
   

  

**About Your Application**
* Please apply in English. At Kustom we welcome everyone! We don’t care where you’re from, whom you love, what kind of food is your favorite (well, unless we’re having a celebration together, then we’ll have to know!), if you believe in this or in that - everyone is welcome!
* Giving the above, we treat all candidates the same! That’s why we have this awesome recruitment tool to keep track of all the amazing talents that apply - so please; apply through the system and we’ll make sure to keep you updated along the recruitment process. And be noticed that we can’t keep track of all CV’s and likewise via email. 🙌
* We value your privacy! When you apply, we'll handle your data with care. Want to know more about how we use your information? Check out our FAQs at the bottom of the jobs page - we've got all the details there for you!

title: Systems Engineer
description:
Är du en teknisk, flexibel och lösningsorienterad person som tycker om att arbeta med systemframtagning, systemdesign och flödet kring krav och verifiering när det kommer till försvars- och informationssystem?
   

  

 Har du ett intresse av att arbeta med framtidens teknik i en innovativ och växande organisation? Vill du hjälpa till att skapa en tryggare vardag genom att utveckla IT-system som fokuserar på samverkan inom Sverige, NATO och dess allierade?
   

  

 Då har vi rätt tjänst för dig!
   

  

**Din nya utmaning**
 Vi söker ett antal systemingenjörer som kan ha lite olika profiler, som tillsammans kommer arbeta för att lösa en stor varians av uppgifter tillsammans. Dessa områden kan inkludera:
   

  

* Krav, kravanalys och assurans
* Systemdesign kring hårdvarusystem med mjukvaruintegration
* Elektronik
* Test och verifiering
* IT-säkerhet


 Med en relativt liten och flexibel organisation så kommer du få en stor varians i arbetsuppgifter, arbeta inom hela projektflödet och få möjlighet att komma i kontakt med flertalet olika projekt. Du kommer ha en central del i att leverera nya försvarsförmågor med kvalitet!
   

  

**Huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter**
* Arbeta med att analysera, bryta ner och realisera systemkrav
* Definiera och dokumentera hur system skall utformas
* Upprätta spårbarhet för att säkerställa assurans mellan krav, design, implementation och tester
* Inrätta verifieringsstrategier, var och när skall delsystem testas för att säkra en fungerande slutleverans
* Ta fram testspecifikationer för olika delsystem inför olika testtillfällen
* Genomförande och analys av testresultat för att säkerställa att systemet fungerar enligt kraven


**Vi söker dig med**
* En kandidatexamen eller motsvarande utbildning inom systemutveckling, elektronik, mekatronik, nätverksteknik, IT-säkerhetsarbete eller motsvarande erfarenhet
* Förmåga att analysera komplexa system och identifiera problem i ett tidigt skede
* Förmåga att skriva tekniska rapporter, kravdokument och testplaner på ett tydligt sätt
* Erfarenhet att arbeta med tvärfunktionella team i projekt med flera discipliner
* Förståelse kring Systems Engineering processer inkl.
+ kravanalys och specifikation
+ spårbarhet och förändringshantering
+ testmetodik och strategi


 Du måste vara svensk medborgare då tjänsten är säkerhetsklassad. Du talar och skriver flytande på svenska och engelska.
   

  

**Lär känna oss**
 På MilDef blir du en del av ett företag som värdesätter praktiskt engagemang, gemenskap och utveckling av ledande försvarsteknik. Hos oss får du möjlighet att utveckla nya färdigheter, bidra i tvärfunktionella projekt och göra en konkret skillnad för vår fortsatta framgång. Vi uppmuntrar kontinuerligt lärande, samarbete, och erbjuder goda möjligheter till karriärutveckling. Vi är stolta över att aktivt främja hälsa och balans mellan arbete och privatliv. Det gör vi bland annat genom att erbjuda attraktiva förmåner samt hälsofrämjande initiativ, som wellness-aktiviteter på arbetstid.
   

  

 Vill du veta mer om MilDef, våra produkter och vår kultur? Läs mer här MilDef.com
   

  

 För mer information om rollen, vänligen kontakta Talent Acquisition.
   

  

**Viktig information**
 Vi tillämpar löpande urval och uppmuntrar dig att skicka in din ansökan redan idag!
   

  

 Tjänsten publiceras under sommarmånaderna, en period då många av oss på MilDef är på semester. Vi kommer därför att återkomma med återkoppling senast i mitten av augusti, tack för ditt tålamod!
   

  

 Vi genomför drogtester på alla våra framtida kollegor innan anställning.
   

  

 På grund av verksamhetens karaktär kan anställning, oavsett befattning, förutsätta bakgrunds- och säkerhetsrelaterade kontroller.
   

  

***MilDef - WE ARMOR IT.***
*MilDef is a global systems integrator and full-spectrum provider specializing in rugged IT for military, government and critical infrastructure sectors. MilDef provides hardware, software, and services that shield and protect critical information streams and systems, when and where the stakes are the highest. MilDef’s products are sold to more than 200 customers through companies in Sweden, Norway, Finland, Denmark, United Kingdom, Germany, Switzerland, the United States and Australia, and through partner networks in more than 40 countries. MilDef was founded in 1997 and is listed on Nasdaq Stockholm since 2021.*

title: Applied AI Lead
description:
EQT is looking for an Applied AI Lead — a delivery-focused engineering leader who brings together technical depth, product instinct, and the credibility to partner with investment professionals, operators, and engineers to turn generative AI from prototype into production. This role sits at the heart of EQT's ambition to become the most AI-literate firm in private markets.
   

  

**About The Team**
 You will lead EQT's Applied AI function, a multidisciplinary team of applied AI engineers, ML engineers, and full-stack builders shipping high-impact generative AI products across Client, Investment Teams, and Fund/Group. The team consumes Tech Foundations' shared AI platform while owning lightweight tooling and operational practices to move with speed.
   

  

**About The Role**
 You will lead a team of engineers deployed on high-impact projects to quickly drive results within both engineering and business teams. You will lead with craft, actively contributing to assignments alongside your leadership duties and you will act as a catalyst, helping engineering teams accelerate AI delivery and maximizing AI impact across business teams. You set the standard for quality and delivery across the team.
   

  

* Lead, mentor, and grow a multidisciplinary Applied AI team with clear expectations for delivery quality and technical craft.
* Own the Applied AI roadmap in close alignment with business stakeholders and value stream teams; stay attuned to emerging AI capabilities and evaluate where new models, agents, or tooling unlock fresh value.
* Partner with Tech Foundations, Product, Data, and Security teams to ensure Applied AI products integrate cleanly and responsibly.
* Serve as the senior AI partner to EQT's business lines — working directly with investment professionals and leaders to translate opportunities into concrete deliverables.
* Drive adoption of shipped products through enablement, demonstrations, training, and active feedback loops with end users.
* Track the AI frontier and apply fresh thinking to raise the bar on what EQT can build.
* Measure and communicate business impact with rigour — instrumenting both engineering productivity gains and user adoption — and hire engineers who understand that judgment about AI output, decomposition skills, and willingness to change workflows matter more than framework credentials.


**About You**
 You are a thoughtful, delivery-oriented leader who combines technical depth with business fluency to navigate private markets. You bring collaborative leadership, sound judgment, and relentless curiosity about where AI creates genuine value in PE.
   

  

**What you'll bring (must-have):**
**Leadership & Credibility:** 
 At least 10 years in software or ML/AI engineering, with 3–5 years in a leadership capacity managing teams or strategic delivery in applied AI, ML product, or AI platform environments.
   

  

**Demonstrated AI Leverage & Outcomes:** 
 Concrete evidence of AI-driven productivity gains: a specific product, workflow, or internal tool you shipped with AI; a measurable before/after (latency, throughput, manual-work elimination); and how you measured it.
   

  

**Willingness to Abandon Habits for Better Tooling:** 
 You've changed your mind on how you write AI systems because a new approach or model capability made the old one obsolete. You ship what works now, not what worked last year, and you bring that standard to how you lead.
   

  

**Working Knowledge of Private Equity & Deal Workflow:** 
 Genuine operational fluency in PE — deal cycles, investment decision-making, portfolio workflows, or comparable high-stakes professional services. You translate vague "investment teams struggle with analysis" into shippable features and know where AI actually applies vs. distraction.
   

  

**Measurement & Instrumentation:** 
 You cultivate a culture of transparency and clarity. You measure impact and productivity not just for dashboards, but to empower your team, identify where we win, and remove barriers to success. You believe that rigorous, data-informed insights create fairness and accountability—enabling you to hire, promote, and develop top-quartile talent who value ‘Owning It’.
   

  

**Stakeholder & Cross-Functional Leadership:** 
 You've translated ambiguous business needs into shippable AI products in close partnership with non-technical stakeholders. You lead across engineering, product, data, and security without formal authority. You've rolled out internal platforms or shared services and know how to drive adoption.
   

  

**Judgment About What's Real vs. Hype:** 
 You follow AI research actively but skeptically — testing whether new capabilities solve problems you care about. You experiment thoughtfully and bring a craft-oriented mindset to your team.
   

  

**Comfort in Ambiguity & Distributed Environments:** 
 You've operated effectively in large, complex organisations across time zones, unclear ownership, and shifting priorities.
   

  

**Nice to have:**
* Direct experience in private equity operations, investing, or portfolio company engagement.
* Experience with data governance, security, and AI compliance frameworks.
* A track record of building strong developer experiences and high-leverage internal tooling.
* Experience enabling AI adoption at an organisational scale, including training, change management, or community building.
* Familiarity with AI infrastructure or platform team environments (beyond applied AI delivery).
* A public track record of open-source contributions, technical writing, or speaking on AI systems design or engineering practices.


**What We Offer**
 EQT offers a rare opportunity to shape how one of the world's leading private markets firms applies AI at scale. You'll work alongside sharp minds in finance and technology, with the mandate and resources to build something genuinely impactful. We're committed to a high-trust environment where what you deliver matters more than tenure.
   

  

 Compensation & Benefits Notice We offer a competitive total rewards package including base salary, determined based on the role, experience, skill set, and location. Eligible employees may also receive discretionary incentive compensation, awarded in recognition of individual performance and company results. EQT provides a comprehensive benefits offering designed to support employee wellbeing, development, and work-life balance. Benefits include paid time off, parental leave, wellbeing and wellness support, flexible working arrangements, and learning and development opportunities. Benefits are effective from the first day of employment and may vary by location and role.
   

  

**Inclusion at** 
**EQT**
*Our vision for EQT employees is to build high performing & engaged teams. Our competitive edge comes from fostering an environment where every individual feels valued, empowered, and motivated to drive business impact. Our commitment to inclusion is not just about fairness; We understand and believe that being a great place to work drives the best performance.At EQT, inclusion is a business imperative and it's embedded into our talent strategy, decision-making, and culture to ensure that every individual and team operates at their full potential. By doing so, we unlock better collaboration, stronger innovation, and superior investment outcomes.*
**About EQT**
*EQT is a purpose-driven global investment organization focused on active ownership strategies. With a Nordic heritage and a global mindset, EQT has a track record of over three decades of developing companies across multiple geographies, sectors and strategies. EQT has investment strategies covering all phases of a business’ development, from start-up to maturity. EQT has EUR ‌ 270 billion in total assets under management (EUR ‌ ‌141 billion in fee-generating assets under management), within two business segments – Private Capital and Real Assets.
   

  

 With its roots in the Wallenberg family’s entrepreneurial mindset and philosophy of long-term ownership, EQT is guided by a set of strong values and a distinct corporate culture. EQT manages and advises funds and vehicles that invest across the world with the mission to future-proof companies, generate attractive returns and make a positive impact with everything EQT does. EQT has offices in more than 25 countries across Europe, Asia and the Americas and has more than 1,900 employees.*
*More info: www.eqtgroup.com
   

  

 Follow EQT on LinkedIn, X, YouTube and Instagram*

title: Product Owner Finance IT

title: Säkerhetsrådgivare / Säkerhetsarkitekt
description:
**Om** 
**jobbet**
 Har du 4–8 års teknisk erfarenhet och vill ta nästa steg inom säkerhetsområdet? Hos oss får du arbeta som rådgivare och arkitekt för några av Sveriges mest spännande företag – samtidigt som du blir en del av Advisenses starka specialistmiljö.
   

  

 Vårt Digital Architecture & Engineering (DAE)-område växer och vi söker nu fler säkerhetsrådgivare/arkitekter som vill vara med på resan. Här möts olika kompetenser inom cybersäkerhet och tillsammans skapar vi en bred och dynamisk miljö. Vi tror att du både förstår och lockas av samspelet mellan affärsbehov och tekniska lösningar. Rollen formas efter din erfarenhet och ambition.
   

  

 Du är aldrig ensam i din roll – vi växer och utvecklas tillsammans.
   

  

**Dina ansvarsområden**
* Stötta kunder i gränslandet mellan operativ säkerhet, strategi och teknik
* Vara drivande i att ställa krav och påverka säkerhetsarkitekturen
* Vidareutveckla och förvalta riktlinjer för IT-säkerhetsarkitektur
* Ge råd om teknologival och riskreducerande åtgärder i hybrida infrastrukturmiljöer
* Bidra inom områden som DevSecOps, IAM (Identity and Access Management), Zero-Trust eller produktsäkerhet
* Delta i tvärfunktionella diskussioner och säkerställa att utveckling och implementation sker enligt gällande arkitektur- och säkerhetskrav
* Hålla seminarier, föreläsningar och bidra till att stärka vår kunskapsbas inom säkerhetsarkitektur och informationssäkerhet
* Delta i försäljningsaktiviteter och utveckla långsiktiga kundrelationer
* Samarbeta med kollegor i Europa i gemensamma projekt.


**Dina Personliga Kompetenser**
 Du är självständig, strukturerad och initiativrik, med ett starkt sinne för affärsmöjligheter och en djup förståelse för konsultrollen. Som passionerad problemlösare trivs du med att hantera komplexa frågor och presentera tydliga lösningar.
   

  

**Din Bakgrund Och Erfarenhet**
* Högskoleutbildning inom informationssäkerhet eller annan relevant teknisk inriktning
* Minst 4 års erfarenhet inom området; konsultbakgrund är meriterande
* Kännedom om ramverk som ISO 27001, CIS Critical Security Controls, svenska grundprinciper för informationssäkerhet, MITRE ATT&CK, NIST CSF, NIS2, SABSA, TOGAF
* Kunskap om molnplattformar (Azure, AWS eller GCP) och deras säkerhetsfunktioner
* Erfarenhet av säkerhet i utvecklingscykler, exempelvis IaC (Infrastructure as Code) och CI/CD
* Goda språkkunskaper: du kan kommunicera obehindrat på svenska och engelska, både muntligt och skriftligt.


**Det här ser vi som meriterande**
* Certifieringar inom informationssäkerhet (t.ex. CISSP, CISM eller liknande)
* Erfarenhet av specifika säkerhetslösningar eller verktyg
* Tidigare arbete med internationella uppdrag eller i globala organisationer


**Vad vi kan erbjuda dig**
 Vi kan erbjuda dig möjligheten att arbeta med ett brett spektrum av spännande kunder och projekt. De flesta finns inom finans- och offentlig sektor, men vi samarbetar också med aktörer inom andra branscher som industrin – många av dem stora och välkända företag med verksamhet även utanför Sverige.
   

  

 Vi tror starkt på glädjen och effektiviteten i teamwork. Hos oss får du lära av erfarna kollegor, bidra med din egen kompetens och samtidigt bygga ditt personliga varumärke. Vi är ett företag byggt på förtroende och erbjuder stor flexibilitet, i en kultur där gemenskapen gör att du faktiskt ser fram emot att gå till jobbet.
   

  

 Som en del av Advisense blir du också viktig för vår tillväxtresa och internationella expansion. Samtidigt vårdar vi den entreprenörsanda och kultur från vårt ursprung som gör oss till både en framgångssaga och en riktigt bra arbetsplats.
   

  

***Företagsbeskrivning***
 Advisense har vuxit till att bli ett marknadsledande expertbolag inom styrning, risk och efterlevnad (GRC – Governance, Risk & Compliance). Genom förvärvet av Transcendent Group under 2022 är vi nu den största oberoende rådgivningsfirman i Norden inom detta område, där vi hjälper våra kunder med rådgivning, tjänster, teknologi och fondlösningar. Vi strävar efter att vara den bästa arbetsplatsen för GRC-experter och har mer än 450 medarbetare på våra kontor i i Belgien, Danmark, Finland, Tyskland, Litauen, Norge och Sverige.
   

  

 Läs mer om oss här
   

  

**Varmt välkommen med din ansökan!**
**Information om vår rekryteringsprocess**
*Om du är intresserad, tveka inte att skicka in din ansökan. Vi kommer att börja intervjua kandidater så snart som möjligt. Observera att vi inte accepterar ansökningar via e-post med hänvisning till GDPR. Vi arbetar kompetensbaserat under hela processen, inklusive arbetspsykologiska tester, intervjuer och referenstagning.*

title: Produktledare inom Datalagring och IoT
description:
Välkommen till oss
   

  

 Infrastrukturavdelningen består av sju enheter med sammanlagt ca 90 medarbetare. Avdelningen har ett brett verksamhetsområde. Utöver att genomföra trafikkontorets stora investeringsprojekt ansvarar avdelningen för att genom underhåll och reinvesteringar säkerställa att broar, tunnlar, trafiksignaler och offentlig belysning behåller sina funktioner och utvecklas för att uppfylla den växande stadens behov.
   

  

 Rollen är placerad på belysningsenheten där du kommer att arbeta tillsammans med 12 engagerade och kompetenta kollegor vars uppdrag är att förvalta stadens offentliga belysning. Du kommer även att arbeta nära kollegorna på systerenheterna Infrateknik och Trafikteknik som förvaltar stadens trafiksignaler och övriga tekniska system så som markvärme, hissar, rulltrappor, ledningstunnlar, fontäner, med mera.
   

  

 Vi söker dig som vill representera verksamheten och leda arbetet med att utveckla datadrivna arbetssätt genom digitalisering, datalagring och IoT.
   

  

 Vi erbjuder
   

  

 Vi har högt ställda ambitioner inom stadens kvalitetsarbete, uppföljning och rapportering och här får du möjlighet att vara med och bidra i centrum av en högt prioriterad fråga. Vi erbjuder dessutom en trygg arbetsplats där vi hjälper och stöttar varandra i det vardagliga arbetet och värnar om den goda arbetsmiljön. Vi har flexibla arbetstider samt möjlighet till växling av semesterdagstillägg mot extra ledighet. Vi satsar på medarbetarnas hälsa och erbjuder generös friskvårdsersättning och friskvårdstimme. Arbetsplatsen är centralt belägen i Tekniska nämndhuset på Fleminggatan 4.
   

  

 Läs gärna mer om Stockholms stad som arbetsgivare: Staden som arbetsgivare - Stockholms stad och våra Förmåner.
   

  

 Välkommen att växa i en växande stad - där din insats verkligen gör skillnad!
   

  

 Din roll
   

  

 Tjänsten innebär att du tar rollen som produktledare verksamhet i Vintergatan som är vår implementering av pm3. Som produktledare hos oss får du en central roll i arbetet med att utveckla såväl enhetens som avdelningens och kontorets arbete med datalagring, dataanalys och IoT-system. Avdelningen har många olika system med anläggningsdata och verksamheten har en önskan om att i högre grad nyttja data för insikter, statisk och datadrivna beslut.
   

  

 I ditt uppdrag ingår att representera verksamheten i förvaltning och utveckling av system och rutiner för datalagring, datakrav och datakvalitet samt de system som styr och övervakar stadens offentliga belysning. Arbetet är såväl strategiskt, taktiskt och operativt med inslag av långsiktig planering, budgetarbete, målarbete, uppföljning, projektledning och leverantörsstyrning.
   

  

 Vidare kommer du bland annat att arbeta med att
   

  

* Delta i objektledningen för två förvaltningsobjekt
* Planera och driva arbetet inom dina produkter tillsammans med IT-enheten och andra verksamhetsspecialister
* Samverka med trafikkontorets alla avdelningar för att samla in, analysera och prioritera verksamhetens behov inom ramen för produkterna
* Driva och/eller delta i upphandling och uppföljning av leverantörsavtal i samverkan med verksamhet och IT
* Driva utveckling av verktyg och processer för datadrivna beslut på avdelningen och enheten


 Din kompetens och erfarenhet
   

  

 Vi söker dig som har
   

  

* relevant högskoleutbildning eller motsvarande flerårig dokumenterad arbetserfarenhet som vi bedömer likvärdig
* erfarenhet från arbete med datalagring (data warehouse, data lake), dataanalys, data governance (datastyrning), uppkopplade styr och övervakningssystem, IoT, eller likvärdigt
* hög förmåga att uttrycka dig på svenska i tal och skrift samt har goda kunskaper i engelska
* god förmåga att arbeta strukturerat och att säkerställa kvalitet i information och data


 Det är meriterande om du även har erfarenhet inom
   

  

* offentlig verksamhet eller inom samhällsbyggnad
* arbete i en roll som exempelvis produktledare, förvaltningsledare, systemförvaltare, projektledare eller liknande inom pm3 eller annan förvaltningsmodell
* arbete med informationssäkerhet, cybersäkerhet, IT-säkerhet, dataskydd eller systemförvaltning
* projektledning, programledning eller förändringsledning
* har förståelse för samspelet mellan medarbetare, processer, IT-system, information och regelverk och hur verksamhetsförmågor skapar värde
* förståelse för tekniska anläggningar i stadsmiljö så som gatubelysning, trafiksignaler eller markvärme


 Vi söker dig som är nyfiken, innovativ och utvecklingsinriktad med god förståelse för värdet och potentialen i data och IoT för offentlig förvaltning. Du är en kommunikativ person med pedagogisk förmåga att omvandla komplexa lösningar till en begriplig kontext
   

  

 och har ett balanserat teknikintresse med verksamhets nyttan som utgångspunkt.
   

  

 Vidare har du förmågan att lyfta blicken och se strategiskt och helhetsorienterat kring hela kontorets behov. Du trivs med att växla mellan självständigt arbete och att samverka med andra för att driva genom beslut och leda aktiviteter.
   

  

**Övrigt**
 Vi rekryterar utan det personliga brevet i denna rekrytering för att stärka fokus på de kompetenser och erfarenheter som efterfrågas för denna roll. Vid bedömningen av din ansökan kommer vi endast att utgå ifrån ditt CV och ett antal frågor du får besvara i samband med att du söker tjänsten. Vi önskar att du svarar konkret och utförligt på frågorna, och att det finns en tydlig koppling mellan dina svar och ditt CV. Vänligen skriv ditt CV på svenska.
   

  

 Arbetspsykologiska tester kan bli aktuella i rekryteringsprocessen.
   

  

 Sista ansökningsdag är den 10 augusti därefter kallar vi till intervjuer under vecka 34 och vecka 35. Eftersom det är semestertider kommer vi att återkoppla först efter 12 augusti.
   

  

 Varmt välkommen med din ansökan!

title: Application Engineer - Technical Customer Lead
description:
**About Applied Intuition**
 Applied Intuition, Inc. is powering the future of physical AI. Founded in 2017 and now valued at $15 billion, the Silicon Valley company is creating the digital infrastructure needed to bring intelligence to every moving machine on the planet. Applied Intuition services the automotive, defense, trucking, construction, mining and agriculture industries in three core areas: tools and infrastructure, operating systems, and autonomy. Eighteen of the top 20 global automakers, as well as the United States military and its allies, trust the company’s solutions to deliver physical intelligence. Applied Intuition is headquartered in Sunnyvale, California, with offices in Washington, D.C.; San Diego; Ft. Walton Beach, Florida; Ann Arbor, Michigan; London; Stuttgart; Munich; Stockholm; Bangalore; Seoul; and Tokyo. Learn more at applied.co.
   

  

*We are an in-office company, and our expectation is that employees primarily work from their Applied Intuition office 5 days a week. However, we also recognize the importance of flexibility and trust our employees to manage their schedules responsibly. This may include occasional remote work, starting the day with morning meetings from home before heading to the office, or leaving earlier when needed to accommodate family commitments.*
 Meet our application engineers!
   

  

 Our Application Engineers act as the glue between our customers and our engineering teams. They are responsible for customer success and drive impact with high-priority customer engagements – hear from them on what life is like at Applied Intuition and what makes their roles so exciting!
   

  

**About The Role**
 (We are hiring for all levels of experience.)
   

  

 We are looking for bright engineers interested in leading customer engagements and owning overall account strategy. Our Technical Customer Leads have a unique mix of software expertise, domain knowledge, and execution driven mindset. Using these skills, they work closely with engineering teams to ensure that Applied’s products are providing maximum impact to advance customers’ autonomy initiatives. This is an important role for the company managing customer relationships and ensuring customer success with Applied’s products and expertise.
   

  

 Check out what a typical day would look like as an Application Software Engineer here!
   

  

**At Applied Intuition, You Will**
* Own account strategy for major enterprise customers of Applied
* Manage executive and leadership relationships
* Work closely with customers to understand their development needs and use cases for autonomy to propose effective use of Applied’s products
* Ensure customer needs are supported by broader engineering team through effective prioritization
* Collaborate with our sales teams to gather requirements through detailed technical discussions and workshops
* Explore new product development areas driven by strategic understanding of customer landscape


**We're Looking For Someone Who Has**
* Experience working with automotive OEMs or suppliers
* Prior work in autonomous vehicle or robotics development domains
* 3+ years as either an application engineer or a developer with experience in interacting with end-customers
* Familiarity with best practices in large scale software development
* Strong communication skills and focus on solving customer problems


**Nice To Have**
* Prior background in technical sales or application engineering for simulation products
* Prior work in autonomous vehicle development domains


**Benefits**
* 30 days of paid vacation per year
* Free daily lunch and dinner in the office, plus breakfast, snacks, and drinks
* Supplemental private health insurance (PrivatAccess Silver) — specialist appointments within 7 working days and surgery within 14, plus long-term sickness income insurance, premium waiver insurance, and group life insurance (TGL)
* Occupational pension: 4.5% of salary up to the statutory income ceiling and 30% of salary above it
* 9,360 SEK annual learning & development and 5,615 SEK annual fitness budget
* 25 free Lyra coaching or therapy sessions per year for you and each of your dependents
* Generous parental leave: on top of statutory parental leave


*Don’t meet every single requirement? If you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.*

These regulations require that covered prime contractors and subcontractors take affirmative action to employ and advance in employment individuals without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status or disability. title: Data Scientist, Product
description:
**TL;DR** 
 - You own the metrics for a product area, find where users get stuck or drop off, and turn that into product bets that ship. You build the measurement and experimentation the teams rely on, and the systems that surface opportunities without waiting on you.
   

  

**Why Lovable?**
 Lovable lets anyone and everyone build software with any language. From solopreneurs to Fortune 100 teams, millions of people use Lovable to transform raw ideas into real products, fast. We are at the forefront of a foundational shift in software creation, which means you have an unprecedented opportunity to change the way the digital world works. Lovable-built applications and websites are visited hundreds of millions of times a month, and our enterprise footprint is compounding fast. And we're just getting started.
   

  

 We're a small, talent-dense team building a generation-defining company from Stockholm. We value extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We seek out people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world.
   

  

**What We're Looking For**
* A product-minded data scientist who owns a product area's outcomes: you find the opportunity, form the bet, and see it shipped, rather than handing insights to a PM.
* You build systems, not one-offs: the instrumentation, metrics, and agents that produce insight and flag opportunities proactively.
* Strong SQL, Python, applied statistics, and experimentation (A/B and growth tests).
* Deep instinct for user behavior: activation, engagement, retention, and what moves them.
* Comfortable shipping directional answers fast, and knowing when a decision needs rigor.
* Entrepreneurial. Thrives with autonomy and ambiguity, and works shoulder to shoulder with product and engineering.


**What You'll Do**
* Own the metrics and funnels for a product area, and drive measurable improvement in activation, engagement, and retention.
* Find opportunities in user behavior and turn them into product bets, working directly with PMs and engineers to ship them.
* Design and run experiments, and act on the results.
* Build the instrumentation, semantic models, and agents the product team runs on.
* Keep the data the team trusts trustworthy: quality, definitions, and lineage.


**Our tech stack**
 We're building with tools that both humans and AI love:
   

  

* Languages: SQL and Python
* Warehouse & events: BigQuery, PubSub
* Analytics & product: Hex, Lovable Apps
* Experimentation: A/B and growth testing
* Cloud: GCP


 And always on the lookout for what's next.
   

  

**How We Hire**
* Fill in a short form and jump on an intro call with our recruiting team
* A call with the hiring team member
* A take-home case study
* A Most Impressive Project session
* Cross-functional interviews with the people you'd work with
* A final conversation with leadership


**About Your Application**
 Please submit your application in English. It's our company language, so you'll be speaking lots of it if you join.
   

  

 We treat all candidates equally. If you're interested, please apply through our careers portal.

title: AI Ops Engineer (People Team)
description:
**TL;DR**
---------


We're looking for an exceptional AI Software Engineer to build the AI-powered People systems that help Lovable scale.


As Lovable grows, we're rethinking how work gets done. Rather than relying on traditional HR software, we're building AI-native products that transform hiring, onboarding, workforce planning, identity, compliance, and other core People workflows.


You'll work embedded with our People team, partnering closely with stakeholders to understand problems, design solutions, and ship production-ready software. Many of the products you build won't stop at improving Lovable internally — they have the potential to become capabilities we offer to customers in the future, giving you the opportunity to shape products that start inside Lovable and scale far beyond it.

**Why Lovable?**
----------------


Lovable lets anyone and everyone build software with any language. From solopreneurs to Fortune 100 teams, millions of people use Lovable to transform raw ideas into real products - fast. We are at the forefront of a foundational shift in software creation, which means you have an unprecedented opportunity to change the way the digital world works. Lovable-built applications and websites are visited hundreds of millions of times a month, and our enterprise footprint is compounding fast. And we’re just getting started.


We’re a small, talent-dense team building a generation-defining company from Stockholm. We value extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We seek out people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world.

**Why join now?**
-----------------


Very few engineering roles offer this level of ownership.


You'll help define how AI transforms internal operations. You'll work directly with the People team to identify problems, design solutions, and build products that improve how Lovable operates every day.


As Lovable scales, we're building the operating system the company runs on—function by function, directly in Lovable. The People team is one of the first. You'll help define how AI transforms one of our most important internal functions, and the best ideas will eventually become building blocks for our customers.

**What we're looking for**
--------------------------


We're looking for a software engineer with strong product instincts and experience building secure software that handles sensitive information.

**You'll likely have:**

* Experience shipping production software that handles sensitive data — HR tech, fintech, identity management, or similar.
* Experience working with people data, business systems, analytics platforms, or enterprise data infrastructure (e.g. BigQuery, Snowflake, Databricks, Airflow, Fivetran, SQL, etc.).
* Deep familiarity with HR systems and/or ATS platforms (HiBob, Ashby, Workday, Greenhouse, or similar), either as a builder or through close collaboration with People teams.
* Experience designing secure systems with role-based access control and data permissioning.
* Strong product instincts—you think end-to-end, ask why, and care about building products people actually use.
* Excellent stakeholder management skills and the ability to translate operational challenges into technical solutions.
* Experience building products from scratch and taking them into production.

**Bonus points if you have:**

* Experience at an HR technology company, Work OS platform, or identity provider,
* Experience with HRIS, ATS, compensation, workforce planning tools.
* Experience building AI-powered products or internal tooling.
* Experience working closely with People or Operations teams.

**What you'll do**
------------------

**In one sentence:**


Build AI-powered People systems that make Lovable run better — and create products that can graduate from internal tools to customer-facing features.

**Examples include:**

* Partner with the People team to identify, scope, and ship AI-powered internal products.
* Build integrations with HR systems (HiBob, Ashby, etc.), ATS platforms, and identity providers.
* Design secure systems with robust role-based permissions and access controls.
* Develop predictive and diagnostic models (workforce trends, hiring capacity, retention risks, compensation dynamics).
* Create canonical datasets and source-of-truth models for hiring, headcount, compensation, organizational design, and workforce planning.
* Data governance — source-of-truth logic, naming conventions, ownership.
* Own products end-to-end—from research and design through implementation, deployment, and iteration.
* Translate operational challenges into elegant technical solutions.
* Build systems that meet legal and compliance requirements for handling sensitive employee data.
* Work closely with other AI Ops Engineers, sharing building blocks, patterns, and learnings across Lovable's functions.
* Build AI agents, workflows, dashboards, and decision-support tools that help leaders make better decisions.

**Our tech stack**
------------------


We're building with tools that both humans and AI love.

**Languages:** TypeScript, Python, Go

**AI:** OpenAI, Anthropic, MCP, AI Agents

**Business Systems:** HiBob, Ashby, Okta

**Infrastructure:** Cloudflare, PostgreSQL, Temporal


We're always looking for better tools and better ways of building software.

**About your application**
--------------------------


Please submit your application in English — it's our company language.


We review every application carefully and encourage anyone excited by the role to apply, even if your background doesn't perfectly match every bullet point.

title: Product Manager
description:
**Build something monumental for Healthcare!**
==============================================

  

At Tandem Health we’re reimagining healthcare by putting clinicians first. Our platform - designed by clinicians, for clinicians - is built on deep insight into real-world pain points, with intuitive medical notes and workflows that truly support patient care.


We’re a fast-scaling health-tech company backed by top investors and expanding globally. We move fast, stay curious, and believe building something that matters starts with an extraordinary team. If you're passionate about impact and innovation, we'd love to meet you!

**About the role**
==================

  

Nowhere is great products as important as in healthcare. They make the difference between well functioning and catastrophic care. Unfortunately the sector has a very bad history of second-rate digital products to date. This is your chance to change that.  

  

As a Product Manager at Tandem, you’ll own a significant product area, working closely with our Senior Product Managers, CTO, and engineering teams to turn our vision into exceptional products. You’ll drive prioritization and execution, helping build products that will underpin the future of healthcare.  

  

You’ve worked in high-performing product organizations, ideally in fast-moving startup or scale-up environments, and know how to balance long-term thinking with rapid execution. You’re also comfortable getting close to the implementation - understanding technical constraints and occasionally directly contributing with the help of agentic engineering, not because you’re an engineer, but because you care about deeply understanding the product.  

  

You have the technical fluency to collaborate closely with engineers and enjoy experimenting with the latest AI tools and modern product development workflows. Most importantly, you’re motivated by the opportunity to build products that have a real impact on healthcare across Europe.  

  

If you’re excited about owning meaningful product initiatives and building technology that improves healthcare at scale, we’d love to meet you.

**What you'll do:**
===================

* Own the strategy and roadmap for one or more products/features, translating Tandem's vision into clear priorities and execution.
* Shape the how product operations are done at an ai native company.
* Translate vision into execution, working closely with Product and Engineering to guide decision-making, prioritization, and delivery.
* Shape products that power healthcare - from core workflows to systems that set new standards in safety, efficiency, and usability.
* Balance user needs, business goals, and technical constraints, ensuring we’re solving the right problems in the right way.
* Foster a culture of rapid iteration, embracing short feedback loops, experiments, and continuous learning.
* Act as a bridge between disciplines, making sure engineers, designers, and stakeholders are aligned and working towards a common outcome.

**Who you are:**
================

* Experience building products in high-performing product organizations, ideally in startup or scale-up environments.
* Strong experience leading product development end-to-end, from strategy through execution.
* Enough technical fluency to collaborate effectively with engineers on complex systems.
* Strong communication and leadership skills, with the ability to align diverse stakeholders around shared goals.

* Trivs i samarbeten där olika kompetenser möts

Vi tror att människor utvecklas bäst när de får rätt förutsättningar. Därför bygger vi en kultur där kompetens, frihet och gemenskap går hand i hand.

title: Senior Product Engineer - Supply Team
description:
Hi! I’m Fedir, Engineering Manager for Team Supply at WeTravel


Our team’s mission is to turn WeTravel from a product into a network. Today a travel operator can run their own business on WeTravel. Next, we want them to plug into each other, co-selling trips, sharing itineraries, and settling commissions automatically, without a single spreadsheet or bank transfer in between. If you want to build the operating system an entire industry runs on, and to be in the room when we decide what that system should be, let’s build something we’re proud of, together!

**About WeTravel**
------------------


Think of the most incredible adventures imaginable: trekking to Machu Picchu, cycling through Tuscany, or going on a safari in Kenya. For years, the small businesses and local experts who run these trips have been stuck using messy spreadsheets, countless emails, and complicated payment methods.


WeTravel is changing that. We build the tools that empower any entrepreneur to launch and grow their own travel business. Our platform makes it simple for organizers to create beautiful trip proposals, securely process payments, and manage their customers, so they can focus on what they do best: creating amazing experiences.


This is one of the last great frontiers of travel to come online, and as the category leader, we are at the forefront of this change. Last year alone, our platform was trusted by 8,000 organizers to lead over a million travelers on adventures in 150+ countries. Now, we’re on an exciting journey to grow from powering $1B to $10B in travel experiences per year.


We believe that every trip, when done right, can be a force for good - and we’re building the engine to make more of that possible.

**What’s the role**
-------------------


Almost no travel operator works alone. Agents, B2C tour operators and destination management companies buy from suppliers, resell each other’s trips, and split the money afterwards. Today that all happens in spreadsheets, WhatsApp threads and PDF quotes; Which is why pricing a trip takes days, and why nobody can tell you two years later how a number was calculated.


Team Supply is building the layer that replaces it. We’re five engineers, and a PM, working on the earliest part of WeTravel’s roadmap: first the single-player OS, how an operator designs a trip, prices it, and sells it, then the multiplayer layer that connects operators to their suppliers and to each other. Getting this right makes WeTravel the tool operators open every morning, and roughly doubles the market we can serve.


You’ll join us to build that foundation and take it from early access to something thousands of operators depend on. What’s on our plate:

* Quoting: a pricing engine in our new service: multiple currencies, tax regimes, margins, seasonal rates.
* Supplier & Product Catalog: a place where operators keep their suppliers, negotiated rates and reusable trip building blocks.
* The Partner Network: supplier onboarding, verification and payouts, so money moves between operators and their suppliers automatically.
* Next up, the explicitly multiplayer pieces: supplier arrangements, commission flows, and a booking marketplace.


It is, in effect, a startup inside a company that already has customers, revenue and scale, much closer to 0 1 than most senior roles you’ll look at this year.

**What you’ll do day-to-day**
-----------------------------

* Lead and build features end-to-end: from reviewing user interviews and product design, through architecture and building systems, to deployment and monitoring in production.
* Partner closely with our product team to discover user problems and shape their solutions, you’ll help decide what is worth building, not only how to build it.
* Write high-quality, maintainable code across both frontend (TypeScript/React) and backend (Ruby on Rails).
* Ensure our services are always on by building resilient applications, making sure they are well monitored, and mitigating incidents as an on-call/incident responder.
* Mentor teammates and contribute to WeTravel’s engineering practices and excellence.

**How we work**
---------------

* We’re focused on the impact. We don’t subscribe to any one framework or execution ideology, and we adapt based on what’s impactful.
* We’re a distributed team: some of us in Amsterdam, the rest remote across Europe.
* We’re using the latest hardware and constantly on the look out for better tools & ways to work.
* Stack: We’re using React/ReactNative/TypeScript + Ruby on Rails and Python Microservices on Kubernetes. We also use and love MongoDB, MySQL, Postgres, Snowflake and we’re working with the major LLM providers.

**You should apply if you have**
--------------------------------

**Basic qualifications**

* 7+ years of software engineering experience (ideally full-stack) with strong product ownership mindset
* Hands-on experience with React and TypeScript, this one is a must. You’ve owned whole apps or large areas of a frontend, and you want to keep doing that.
* Solid backend experience in any recognized modern language: Python, Go, Java/Kotlin, .NET, Node/TypeScript, Ruby. Depth and engineering judgment matter to us more than the specific language.
* Built and launched something new in a startup or scale-up, and stayed with it as it grew (0 1 100)
* Breadth over narrow specialization: you’ve worked across the stack and across different kinds of problems, and you move to where the work is
* Experience building applications working with distributed systems, microservices and event-driven architecture, with strong systems thinking and an eye for scalability
* Experience operating applications in production: monitoring, alerting and on-call
* Excellent communication skills and experience working in multicultural, distributed teams
* Experience leading projects and mentoring other engineers
* Experience using AI assistants like Cursor, Claude Code, Codex etc

**Preferred qualifications**

* Ruby on Rails. It’s our backend stack, so it’s a plus, but we hire for general engineering strength and expect a strong engineer to pick it up.
* Experience in an adjacent domain: marketplaces, supplier or vendor networks, payments and fintech, travel-tech, B2B2C platforms, or quoting / booking / costing systems. A plus, never a requirement.
* Comfortable running your own infrastructure (AWS / Kubernetes)
* Building and maintaining component libraries and working with a design system; micro front-ends; React Native
* Recent experience in building AI-enabled or Agentic applications
* Direct experience with customer interviews and user research

**You might not be the right fit if you**
-----------------------------------------

* Prefer to work in isolation rather than working closely with product teams
* Are uncomfortable with end-to-end responsibility from conception to production monitoring
* Would rather receive well-specified tickets than help decide what to build
* Don’t enjoy learning new technologies or adapting to different tech stacks
* Are not interested in understanding user problems and business context
* Prefer purely technical roles without product ownership responsibilities
* Are uncomfortable with the ambiguity that comes with building new products in a growing team

**Why join us?**
----------------

* Make a real impact: you’ll help build the operating system for the multi-day group travel industry, empowering thousands of organizers and millions of travelers worldwide.
* Solve meaningful technical challenges at scale, from designing robust systems to improving real-time user experiences in a complex domain.
* Be part of building the best engineering team: you’ll help shape culture, mentor others, and contribute to high standards of excellence and collaboration.
* Enjoy flexibility and balance, with competitive compensation, generous PTO, remote-friendly work culture, and annual company offsites (our last one was in Italy ).

**Benefits**
------------

* Attractive compensation.
* Full-time - Fixed Term Contract (as International Contractor).
* Generous "Time to Recharge" policy — enjoy unlimited paid time off to rest, recharge, and show up as your best self.
* Amsterdam Program – visit us in Amsterdam (HQ) for 2-4 weeks every year, staying in one of our WeTravel apartments.
* Although this is a remote role, employees are hired into a designated country of employment. Our Work From Anywhere perk provides eligible employees with up to four weeks per calendar year to work temporarily from another approved location.
* Extensive paid family leave.
* Three paid volunteer days per year — take time to give back to causes you care about, on us.
* 2-week cross-functional onboarding program.
* Cutting-edge equipment and tools to set you up for success. Coverage for certain work-from-home (WFH) equipment.
* Cambly for colleagues for whom English is not their first language.
* Join an international, travel-loving team with a passion for adventure and innovation.

**Please note:**

* As a member of our international team, you’ll work full-time under a B2B contractor agreement, with monthly payments in USD.

**Equal Opportunities**
-----------------------


WeTravel is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. If you're excited about this opportunity and believe you're a good fit, we encourage you to apply and join us in transforming the travel industry!

title: Brand Designer, AI & Ops
description:
**TL;DR** - We're looking for a world-class brand designer who treats generative AI and custom tooling as a primary production method for brand work. You'll direct AI output at volume, both across Lovable’s brand and creative and Lovable’s output itself. You’ll be working closely with a Brand Engineer to ensure whatever workflow you wish for can scale. This is a new role with no precedent - you’ll be defining a lot of it as you go.

 **Why Lovable?**


Lovable lets anyone and everyone build software with any language. From solopreneurs to Fortune 100 teams, millions of people use Lovable to transform raw ideas into real products - fast. We are at the forefront of a foundational shift in software creation, which means you have an unprecedented opportunity to change the way the digital world works. Lovable-built applications and websites are visited hundreds of millions of times a month, and our enterprise footprint is compounding fast. And we're just getting started.


We're a small, talent-dense team building a generation-defining company from Stockholm. We value extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We seek out people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world.

**What we're looking for**

* Strong design taste - you can tell good from generic, and you can articulate why
* Real fluency with AI generation tools (image, video, whatever's next) as a craft, not a party trick - you already have opinions about which models and workflows produce better output and why
* Experience creating scalable brand systems, templates, tools, and guidelines that enable teams to execute independently - except here the "team" increasingly includes the AI pipeline itself
* A portfolio of shipped brand assets - campaign visuals, social graphics, presentation decks, event materials, marketing collateral - plus evidence of AI-native production, not just AI-assisted
* Comfortable with ambiguity - this function doesn't have a template at Lovable or anywhere else yet
* Technical range - prompt engineering counts, scripting, automation and building custom tools is even better. We're not asking you to be an engineer, but the more range you have the faster the seam between you and the Brand Engineer disappears.

**What you'll do**


In one sentence: Shape how the world sees and experiences Lovable, using AI as the primary means of production.

* Evolve Lovable's visual identity across all brand touchpoints
* Build and maintain the visual system as something machines can execute against: style references, fine-tunes/LoRAs, prompt libraries, not just a static guidelines deck
* Direct and review AI-generated output at volume across campaigns, social, events, and partnerships - you're the judgment layer, not the hands
* Establish brand guidelines and systems that ensure consistency as we scale rapidly, in an AI-native production model
* Work closely with a Brand Engineer who builds the tooling that lets you do this at scale - you define what the tools need to produce, they build the systems to scale and maintain them
* Be scrappy and hands-on with whatever the brand needs - from a LinkedIn carousel to event signage, hand-made when hand-making is the point
* Help set the bar for creative quality and taste at Lovable

**How we hire**

* Fill in a short form then jump on an initial exploratory call.
* We'll send you a quick take-home asking to present your best work over a loom video presentation.
* Join us for a round of interviews to discuss your experience in more depth
* Join us for trial work lasting 1-2 days remote or on-site. We'll see how you tick and you get to meet the team and explore whether joining Lovable feels right for you.

title: Software Engineering Analyst
description:
**Software, the fuel for mobility**  

  

We bring bold digital visions to life. So we’re on the lookout for more curious and creative engineers who want to create change – one line of high-quality code at a time. Our transformation isn't for everyone, but if you're excited about solving the leading-edge technological challenges facing the auto industry, then let’s talk about your next move.

**Let's introduce ourselves**
-----------------------------

  

At Volvo Cars, we're on an ambitious journey to redefine the future of mobility. Safety has always been at the heart of everything we do – and today, that mission extends deep into our self-driving and driver-assistance technologies. Within R&D, our AD/ADAS organisation develops the features that help our customers drive safer, smoother and with more confidence every day, from Pilot Assist to highway autonomous drive and beyond.  

  

You'll join a cross-functional team that acts as the "detectives" of our AD/ADAS development. When a complex, system-level issue appears in a test fleet vehicle and no single team owns it, we're the ones who step in, trace it end-to-end, and make sure it gets solved – and that we learn from it.  

  

What we offer:

  

* A chance to shape features that genuinely matter for road safety, at a company where safety is more than a slogan.
* A modern R&D environment in Gothenburg with access to test vehicles, rigs and a strong AD/ADAS ecosystem.
* A culture that values curiosity, collaboration and personal growth, with strong support for continuous learning.
* Competitive compensation, flexible working, and the Volvo Cars benefits package.
**What you'll do**
------------------

  

As a System Analyst, you'll lead system-level issue analysis for our AD/ADAS features. Your work will directly influence the quality of features our customers rely on every day. In this role, you will:

  

* Lead fault tracing of complex, unclear issues that span multiple functions, software releases and teams.
* Translate fuzzy problem statements from the field into clear hypotheses, reproducible findings and concrete corrective actions.
* Decide independently where to focus testing, when to escalate, and which stakeholders to involve – often under time pressure close to a release.
* Drive exploratory and pre-merge testing on our ADAS test fleet, including hands-on work with vehicles, logs and signals (FlexRay, CAN, Ethernet, in-vehicle diagnostics).
* Drive lessons learned back into system design and test coverage ("shift-left"), so the same issue doesn't appear twice.
* Run KPI and fault analysis to spot trends, prioritise the right problems and shorten the lead time from "fault found" to "fault fixed".
* Support the launch of new car programs and features by identifying risks early, before formal verification gates.
* Collaborate closely with design, verification & validation, program management and our partners – including Zenseact.
**What you'll bring**
---------------------

  

We're looking for an engineer who thrives in ambiguity, loves digging into data, and gets energy from solving the problems no one else can crack. You likely have:

  

* A degree in Electrical/Electronic Engineering, Computer Science, Mechatronics, Vehicle Engineering or similar.
* Solid experience with embedded automotive systems – ideally in AD/ADAS, active safety, powertrain or another safety-critical domain.
* Hands-on experience in system-level fault tracing, root-cause analysis and exploratory vehicle testing.
* Strong skills in log and signal analysis (FlexRay/CAN/Ethernet, Wireshark, in-vehicle diagnostics tools) and scripting in Python.
* A good understanding of V&V processes and modern software development flows (CI/CD, pre-merge testing, fault reporting).
* Fluency in English; Swedish is a plus, not a requirement.

  

  

Who you are:

  

* You're curious and analytical – the kind of person who isn't satisfied until you understand *why*.
* You take ownership of unclear, unowned problems and drive them to closure.
* You communicate clearly with both deeply technical engineers and program-level stakeholders.
* You build trust across teams and influence without needing formal authority.
* You're pragmatic: you balance speed and rigour, and you know when to dig deeper and when to ship.
  

**Volvo Cars. For Life.**  

  

For nearly a century, Volvo Cars has empowered people to move freely in a personal, sustainable and safe way. Today, we are driving bold advancements in electrification, sustainability and automotive safety. To realise our ambitious vision, we are seeking innovative minds who are ready to tackle the challenges of tomorrow – today.
  

  

At Volvo Cars, we believe extraordinary things are achieved by ordinary people with a passion for making a difference. If you’re inspired by the opportunity to help redefine the future of mobility, we invite you to be part of our journey.  

  

**Ready to take the next step?**  

  

Submit your CV in English and tell us why you’re the ideal candidate for a role at Volvo Cars. Applications must be received no later than 16th of August 2026. You will receive a confirmation email after your submission.  

  

As part of the recruitment process, the final candidates will undergo a background check.  

  

We welcome your application!

description:

R&D Unit Lead

**Your role and responsibilities**
----------------------------------


Are you interested in shaping the next generation of high-quality, scalable and easy configurable softstarters within ABB’s Electrification business area? Would you like to apply your expertise in a challenging and fascinating environment in a global and diverse company?


Then, join our team of highly motivated engineers as a R&D engineer for electronics hardware development, and contribute to the foundations of next-generation ABB products. You will maintain our active product portfolio, contribute creative ideas to product realization initiatives and propose innovative development projects addressing customer specific requirements. We provide an agile, dynamic workplace and you will be part of a cross-functional agile team embedded in a global network of collaborating teams.


We expect that you show a high motivation, hands-on attitude as well as taking initiative to come up with new ideas that tackle today’s challenges.

* You design, develop, and implement analog and digital circuits from concept phase to serial production.
* Your tasks include creation of schematics and definition of constraints for PCB layout, definition of verification specifications and execution of verification activities of your designs by simulation and prototype testing, as well as documentation and handover of the developed technologies with subsequent implementation support to production engineering.
* You collaborate closely with product owner, product management, system architects and software developers to breakdown market requirements to product requirements for hardware.
* You monitor technology developments and product technologies to identify technical drivers for R&D projects, supported by your thorough understanding of key business drivers for ABB’s products and solutions.
* You participate in internal and external networks to expand your knowledge of your area of expertise.

**Qualifications for the role**
--------------------------------

* M.Sc. or B.Sc degree in Electronic Engineering, Embedded Systems or comparable field
* At least 5 years of experience in development of electronics within embedded systems as a hardware design engineer in an industrial context
* Sound knowledge in designing electronic circuits, circuit diagrams, and working with simulation tools
* Experience in testing and validation of prototypes in a laboratory. Proven experience in working with voltage levels up to ~1kV would be considered a plus
